The skin looks light because it is. It is wheat starch and tapioca, so the carbs are modest and there is barely any fat unless the kitchen is heavy-handed. The prawns are the whole point. This is the dish you load up on first so you are already half full before the fried trolley comes around.
lighter: Order har gao first, before you are tempted by the fried stuff. Two baskets of prawn dumplings is still under 450 calories.
Go easy on the chilli oil and the sweet sauce. A heavy spoon of chilli oil can quietly add 50 to 80 calories per basket.
Pair it with Chinese tea, not a sweet drink. The tea is free calories saved and it cuts the grease.

faq.q: Is har gao good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the better dim sum picks. At about 55 calories a piece with real prawn protein and no deep frying, har gao gives you a lot of satisfaction for the calories. Just watch how many baskets stack up.

faq.q: How much protein is in har gao?
faq.a: A basket of 4 has about 12g of protein, almost all of it from the prawns. That is a solid amount for something this light, which is why it is a smart first order at dim sum.

faq.q: Is har gao healthier than siew mai?
faq.a: Slightly, yes. Har gao is pure prawn and steamed, so it is a bit lower in fat than siew mai, which uses fattier pork. Both are fine, but if you are counting, har gao edges it.

foods.name: Siew Mai
foods.metaDescription: A basket of 4 siew mai is about 260 calories. The open-topped pork and prawn dumpling, broken down with macros and smarter ordering tips.
foods.summary: The open-faced pork and prawn dumplings with the orange dot on top. Higher protein, a bit more fat than har gao.
foods.answer: A basket of 4 siew mai (the open-topped pork-and-prawn dumplings, usually with a little crab roe or carrot on top) is about 260 calories, roughly 65 each. The filling is mostly minced pork and prawn, so it is high in protein but carries more fat than har gao because pork is fattier.
realTalk: Siew mai is the other smart order at dim sum bro. Mostly meat, steamed, no batter, no deep frying. A basket of 4 is around 260 calories and packs 16g of protein. That is genuinely good. The only reason it is not as light as har gao is the pork. Pork mince has fat in it and that is where the extra calories live.

The thing people get wrong is treating the whole trolley the same. Siew mai and har gao are the protein. The buns, the fried taro, the radish cake, those are the carb-and-oil bombs. If half your table order is steamed dumplings, you can eat a proper amount of food and still walk out under control.
lighter: Stick to steamed siew mai. Avoid the deep-fried variants some places do.
Two baskets of siew mai plus a pot of tea is a legit high-protein meal for around 520 calories.
Skip the extra soy sauce drowning. The dumplings are already seasoned, and you do not need the sodium load.

faq.q: Is siew mai high in protein?
faq.a: Yes. A basket of 4 has about 16g of protein from the pork and prawn filling. For a dim sum item it is one of the most protein-dense things you can order, which makes it a good pick if you are trying to stay full.

faq.q: Why is siew mai higher in calories than har gao?
faq.a: Because of the pork. Siew mai uses minced pork which carries more fat than the pure prawn in har gao. The extra fat is what pushes it from about 55 to about 65 calories per piece.

faq.q: Can I eat siew mai on a diet?
faq.a: Yes, in sensible amounts. Steamed siew mai is meat-heavy and filling. The trap is not the dumplings, it is everything fried that comes with them. Keep the order steamed and you are fine.

foods.name: Lo Mai Kai
foods.metaDescription: One bowl of lo mai kai is about 380 calories. Steamed glutinous rice with chicken, broken down with macros and where the calories really hide.
foods.summary: Steamed glutinous rice with chicken, mushroom and a little sausage. Looks innocent, eats heavy.
foods.answer: One bowl of lo mai kai (the steamed glutinous rice with chicken, mushroom and a bit of lap cheong) is about 380 calories. The rice is the story here. Glutinous rice is dense and it is usually mixed with oil and the fatty juices from the chicken and sausage, so a small bowl carries more calories than it looks.
realTalk: Lo mai kai is the sneaky one bro. It looks like a small bowl of rice with a few bits of chicken. Harmless. But glutinous rice is heavy, and the whole thing is steamed in oil, soy and the fat that renders out of the chicken and lap cheong. One bowl is around 380 calories, and it is mostly carbs and fat with only a little protein.

It is not a bad food. It is just calorie-dense for the volume, which is the opposite of what you want when you are trying to stay full on fewer calories. If you love it, have it, but treat one bowl as a proper portion of your meal, not a side dish you add on top of three baskets of dumplings.
lighter: Treat lo mai kai as your carb for the meal, not an extra. One bowl already covers your rice.
Share it. Half a bowl with a basket of har gao is a far more balanced order than a full bowl on its own.
Pick off the visible lap cheong if you are counting. The Chinese sausage is one of the fattiest parts of the bowl.

faq.q: Why is lo mai kai so high in calories?
faq.a: Glutinous rice is dense and calorie-heavy, and lo mai kai is steamed with oil, soy sauce and the fat from the chicken and lap cheong. A small bowl ends up around 380 calories, mostly carbs and fat.

faq.q: Is lo mai kai healthy?
faq.a: It is fine in moderation but it is not a light food. The protein from the chicken is modest while the carbs and fat are high. Treat one bowl as your rice for the meal rather than a small side.

faq.q: How much protein is in lo mai kai?
faq.a: About 14g per bowl, mostly from the chicken. For the calories involved that is not a lot of protein, which is why it is better thought of as a carb dish than a protein one.

foods.name: Char Siew Bao
foods.metaDescription: One steamed char siew bao is about 240 calories. The fluffy BBQ pork bun broken down, with the baked version compared and lighter tips.
foods.summary: The fluffy white steamed bun stuffed with sweet BBQ pork. Soft, sweet, and more carbs than you think.
foods.answer: One steamed char siew bao (the soft white BBQ pork bun) is about 240 calories. Most of that is the fluffy bun itself, which is enriched flour and sugar. The char siew filling adds the protein and a hit of sweetness from the sauce. The baked version with the glazed top runs higher, closer to 280 to 320.
realTalk: Everyone underestimates the bao bro. It looks light and fluffy so your brain files it as a small snack. But that soft white dough is enriched flour plus sugar, and the char siew inside is glazed in a sweet, slightly oily sauce. One steamed bun is around 240 calories, and almost no one stops at one.

The baked char siew bao, the golden glazed kind, is even heavier because the top is brushed with sugar and egg wash and sometimes butter. If you are choosing, the plain steamed white bao is the lighter call. Either way, one bao is a snack with the calories of a small meal, so count it properly.
lighter: Pick the steamed white bao over the baked glazed one. The bake adds sugar, egg wash and sometimes butter on top.
One bao plus a couple of baskets of steamed dumplings is plenty. You do not need two buns.
Drink unsweetened Chinese tea with it. The bun is already sweet, so a sweet drink on top is double the sugar.

faq.q: How many calories in a char siew bao?
faq.a: A steamed char siew bao is about 240 calories. The baked, glazed version is higher, around 280 to 320, because of the sugar and egg wash brushed on top.

faq.q: Is char siew bao fattening?
faq.a: It is more carb-heavy than fatty. The fluffy bun is enriched flour and sugar, so the calories come mainly from refined carbs. It is fine occasionally, but two or three buns adds up fast.

faq.q: Steamed or baked char siew bao, which is lighter?
faq.a: The steamed white bun is lighter. The baked version gets a sugar and egg-wash glaze and sometimes butter, which pushes it 60 to 80 calories higher per bun.

foods.name: Fried Wonton
foods.metaDescription: A plate of 6 fried wonton is about 360 calories. The crispy deep-fried pork and prawn parcels broken down, with macros and lighter swaps.
foods.summary: Crispy deep-fried wonton parcels with a pork and prawn filling. The crunch is pure fryer, so they punch hard for the size.
foods.answer: A plate of 6 fried wonton (the crispy deep-fried parcels of pork and prawn, often served with mayo or sweet chilli) is about 360 calories, roughly 60 each. The filling is small and the wrapper is thin, but deep-frying a thin wrapper means it soaks up oil, so these are one of the heavier-per-bite items at yum cha.
realTalk: Fried wonton is the snack that vanishes off the table bro. They are small, crispy and moreish, so a plate of 6 is gone before you have clocked it. But each one is a thin wrapper deep-fried until crunchy, and that crunch is oil. A plate lands around 360 calories, and the dipping sauce, especially if it is mayo, only adds to it.

The actual filling, a little pork and prawn, is tiny. You are mostly eating fried dough. If you want the same flavour lighter, steamed wonton in soup is a fraction of the calories because there is no fryer involved. Fried ones are fine as a shared starter, just do not treat a whole plate as nothing.
lighter: Order wonton in soup instead of fried if you want the same filling for far fewer calories.
Skip the mayo dip. A spoon of mayo can add 90 to 100 calories to the plate on its own.
Share a plate as a starter rather than having six to yourself on top of everything else.

faq.q: How many calories in fried wonton?
faq.a: About 60 calories per piece, so a plate of 6 is around 360. The filling is small, so most of the calories come from the thin wrapper soaking up oil in the deep fryer.

faq.q: Are fried or steamed wonton healthier?
faq.a: Steamed or soup wonton is much lighter because there is no frying. The same parcels in soup are roughly half the calories of a fried plate, so choose soup if you are watching it.

faq.q: Why are fried wonton so calorie-dense?
faq.a: A thin wrapper has a lot of surface area, and deep-frying it means it absorbs oil all over. That is why a light-feeling, crunchy snack still adds up to around 360 calories for a plate of 6.

foods.name: Lo Bak Go
foods.metaDescription: A plate of 3 pan-fried lo bak go is about 300 calories. The radish cake broken down, steamed vs pan-fried, with macros and lighter tips.
foods.summary: Pan-fried radish cake with a crispy edge and soft middle. More rice flour and oil than actual radish.
foods.answer: A plate of 3 pan-fried lo bak go (radish or turnip cake) is about 300 calories. Despite the name, it is mostly rice flour with shredded radish, bits of dried shrimp and lap cheong, then pan-fried in oil to crisp the edges. The pan-frying is where a chunk of the calories comes from. Steamed and uncrisped, the same cake is lighter.
realTalk: Lo bak go sounds healthy because it has radish in the name bro, but do not be fooled. The base is rice flour, not vegetable. The radish is shredded in for flavour and texture, but the bulk is starch. Then they pan-fry it in oil so the outside goes golden and crispy, and that oil is calories you cannot see.

A plate of 3 is around 300 calories, and most people order it crispy because that is the good version. If you want it lighter you can ask for it steamed rather than pan-fried, but honestly the crispy edge is half the reason to eat it. Just know what you are getting and count it as a carb-and-oil dish, not a veg.
lighter: Ask for it steamed instead of pan-fried if you want to cut the oil. You lose the crispy edge but save 60 to 90 calories a plate.
Go light on the sweet chilli or XO sauce on the side. It adds up quickly across a plate.
Treat it as your carb, not a side. A plate of radish cake plus dumplings means you do not need rice or noodles too.

faq.q: Is lo bak go healthy?
faq.a: It is mostly rice flour rather than radish, so it is more of a carb dish than a vegetable. Steamed it is reasonable, but the popular pan-fried version adds oil that pushes a plate of 3 to around 300 calories.

faq.q: How many calories in radish cake?
faq.a: About 100 calories per piece pan-fried, so a typical plate of 3 is around 300. Steamed and uncrisped, each piece is closer to 70, making a plate about 220.

faq.q: Is turnip cake the same as radish cake?
faq.a: Yes. Lo bak go is translated as both turnip cake and radish cake, but it is made with Chinese white radish (daikon), not turnip. The nutrition is the same whichever name the menu uses.

foods.name: Wu Kok
foods.metaDescription: Two wu kok (fried taro puffs) are about 300 calories. The deep-fried yam dumpling broken down, with macros and why it is the heaviest item on the trolley.
foods.summary: Deep-fried taro puffs with a lacy, crispy shell and savoury pork mince inside. Delicious, and the heaviest thing on the trolley.
foods.answer: Two wu kok (the deep-fried taro or yam puffs with the lacy crispy outside) are about 300 calories, roughly 150 each. The crispy honeycomb shell is mashed taro mixed with fat then deep-fried, so it soaks up oil. It is one of the most calorie-dense things on the dim sum trolley, and the filling of seasoned pork only adds to it.
realTalk: Wu kok is the one to be careful with bro. That gorgeous lacy crispy shell does not happen for free. It is mashed taro bound with fat, then deep-fried, and deep-fried mashed starch drinks oil like nothing else. One single puff is around 150 calories. Two and you are at 300, for what feels like a light, airy snack.

I am not saying never eat it. It is genuinely one of the best-tasting things on the trolley. I am saying respect it. This is the opposite of har gao. Same 300 calories gets you nearly six prawn dumplings full of protein, or two taro puffs that are mostly oil and starch. Pick your spots.
lighter: Limit it to one piece if the table has ordered it. One wu kok as a treat is fine, the whole basket is not.
Balance it. If you are having fried wu kok, make the rest of your order steamed dumplings to keep the meal in check.
Let it drain on the paper for a minute before eating. It will not save much, but the looser oil does come off.

faq.q: Why is wu kok so high in calories?
faq.a: The crispy lacy shell is mashed taro bound with fat and then deep-fried, so it absorbs a lot of oil. That is why a single taro puff is around 150 calories despite feeling light and airy.

faq.q: Is wu kok the unhealthiest dim sum?
faq.a: It is one of the heaviest. Deep-fried items like wu kok and fried wonton carry the most calories per bite. If you are watching it, balance one puff against mostly steamed orders.

faq.q: What is wu kok made of?
faq.a: Mashed taro (yam) formed into a shell around a savoury pork mince filling, then deep-fried until the outside turns into a crispy honeycomb lace. The taro shell is where most of the calories sit.

foods.name: Liu Sha Bao
foods.metaDescription: One liu sha bao (salted egg custard bun) is about 190 calories. The molten salted-yolk lava bun broken down, with macros and honest ordering tips.
foods.summary: The molten salted egg custard bun. That golden lava centre is sugar, butter and salted yolk, so it punches above its size.
foods.answer: One liu sha bao (the steamed bun with the molten salted egg yolk custard) is about 190 calories. The bun is light, but the lava filling is made with salted egg yolk, butter, sugar and custard powder, which is rich and calorie-dense. For a small bun it carries more fat and sugar than you would guess from the size.
realTalk: Liu sha bao is the influencer darling of dim sum now bro, that money shot of the golden lava pouring out. And yeah it is incredible. But understand what that lava is: salted egg yolk, butter, sugar and custard powder. That is basically a dessert filling. One small bun is around 190 calories, and the fat-and-sugar density is high for the size.

It is a treat, full stop. Do not file it next to har gao in your head as just another steamed thing. The bun being steamed does not make the molten butter-and-yolk centre light. One is a nice end to the meal. Three of them is a dessert course you did not account for.
lighter: Treat it as dessert and have one. The filling is rich enough that one usually satisfies.
If you are also eating egg tarts, pick one or the other. Both are sweet, fatty finishers and they double up fast.
Eat it fresh and slow. It is rich, so giving it a moment helps you stop at one rather than reaching for the next.

faq.q: How many calories in liu sha bao?
faq.a: About 190 calories for one salted egg custard bun. The bun is light but the molten centre is made with salted yolk, butter and sugar, so it is richer than its size suggests.

faq.q: Is liu sha bao unhealthy?
faq.a: It is a treat rather than an everyday food. The lava filling is high in fat and sugar, so it behaves more like a dessert. One is fine, but it is easy to eat several without noticing the calories.

faq.q: What is inside a salted egg custard bun?
faq.a: A molten custard made from salted duck egg yolk, butter, sugar and custard powder, wrapped in a soft steamed bun. That rich filling is where most of the calories come from.

foods.name: Xiao Long Bao
foods.metaDescription: A basket of 5 xiao long bao is about 320 calories. The Shanghai soup dumpling broken down, with macros and why the broth inside counts too.
foods.summary: Shanghai soup dumplings with hot broth sealed inside. Thin skin, pork filling, and a mouthful of rich soup each.
foods.answer: A basket of 5 xiao long bao (the Shanghai soup dumplings) is about 320 calories, roughly 65 each. Each one is a thin wheat skin around minced pork and a pocket of rich, gelatin-set broth that melts into soup when steamed. The pork and the broth are both fatty, so they are heavier than they look for such delicate little dumplings.
realTalk: Xiao long bao feels light because the skin is so thin and the whole thing is one elegant bite bro. But that soup inside is not water, it is rich pork broth set with gelatin and fat, and the filling is fatty pork mince. A basket of 5 is around 320 calories. Not crazy, but more than the delicate look suggests.

It is still a decent order. You get 15g of protein from the pork, it is steamed, and it is genuinely satisfying because the hot broth makes each one feel substantial. Just do not treat a couple of baskets as a light snack. Two baskets is 640 calories, which is a full meal, soup dumplings or not.
lighter: One basket plus a side of greens is a tidy, protein-led meal. You do not need three baskets.
Go easy on the black vinegar and ginger only if sodium is your concern. Calorie-wise the dip is nearly free, so that part is fine.
Skip the fried sides that often come with it. The dumplings themselves are the sensible part of the order.

faq.q: Are xiao long bao healthy?
faq.a: They are a reasonable steamed option with about 15g of protein per basket of 5. They are not as light as they look though, because the filling and the soup inside are both fatty pork, putting a basket around 320 calories.

faq.q: How many calories in one xiao long bao?
faq.a: About 65 calories each, so a typical basket of 5 is around 320. The hidden part is the broth, which is rich pork stock set with gelatin, not plain water.

faq.q: Is the soup inside xiao long bao high in calories?
faq.a: It adds up. The soup is concentrated pork broth set into jelly with natural fat, so it is more calorie-dense than it seems. It is part of why these are heavier than their delicate size suggests.

foods.name: Chicken Feet (Phoenix Claws)
foods.metaDescription: A plate of dim sum chicken feet is about 280 calories. The braised phoenix claws broken down, with macros and why the skin makes them fattier than they look.
foods.summary: Braised, deep-fried then steamed chicken feet in a sweet-savoury black bean sauce. More fat and skin than meat.
foods.answer: A plate of dim sum chicken feet (phoenix claws) is about 280 calories. They are usually deep-fried first to puff the skin, then braised and steamed in a sweet black bean and soy sauce. There is not much actual meat on a chicken foot. It is mostly skin, cartilage and collagen, so despite the small size they carry a fair bit of fat.
realTalk: Chicken feet are a funny one bro. People assume they are light because there is barely any meat on them, but that is exactly the problem. What is there is mostly skin and cartilage, and the skin is fat. On top of that the classic prep deep-fries them first to get the puffy texture, then braises them in a sweet, slightly oily sauce.

So a plate ends up around 280 calories, and a big chunk of that is fat from the skin plus sugar from the sauce. You do get decent protein from the collagen, around 18g, so it is not empty. Just do not assume that because you are gnawing tiny bones you are eating light. The sauce and the skin tell a different story.
lighter: Enjoy them, but count them honestly as a fattier item, not a free protein nibble.
Scrape off some of the thick sweet sauce if you want to trim a little sugar and oil.
Pair them with steamed greens or har gao so the meal is not all rich, fatty plates.

faq.q: Are chicken feet high in calories?
faq.a: For their size, yes. A dim sum plate is around 280 calories. There is little meat, so most of what you eat is skin and cartilage, and the skin plus the sweet braising sauce make them fattier than they look.

faq.q: Do chicken feet have protein?
faq.a: About 18g per plate, mostly from collagen and connective tissue. It is real protein, but it comes packaged with a lot of fat from the skin, so the calories ride along with it.

faq.q: Are dim sum chicken feet deep-fried?
faq.a: Usually yes. The classic method deep-fries them to puff the skin, then braises and steams them in black bean sauce. That first frying step is part of why they are more calorie-dense than expected.

foods.name: Spring Rolls (Chun Guen)
foods.metaDescription: Two fried spring rolls are about 260 calories. The crispy chun guen broken down, with macros and how it compares to fresh popiah.
foods.summary: Crispy deep-fried spring rolls with a veg and sometimes prawn filling. The crunch comes straight from the fryer.
foods.answer: Two fried spring rolls (chun guen) are about 260 calories, roughly 130 each. The filling is usually shredded vegetables with a little prawn or pork, which is light enough on its own. The calories come from the wrapper soaking up oil in the deep fryer. The crispier the roll, the more oil it has taken on.
realTalk: Spring rolls are the classic everyone forgets to count bro. The filling is just veg and a bit of prawn, so people think light. But the whole point of a spring roll is the deep-fried crispy wrapper, and a thin wrapper deep-fried is basically an oil sponge. Two rolls land around 260 calories, mostly from that.

If you want the same idea without the fryer, fresh popiah is the move, soft skin, same kind of filling, no deep frying. That said, a couple of fried spring rolls as part of a bigger order is not the end of the world. Just remember it is a fried item and budget it like one, not like a plate of vegetables.
lighter: Go for fresh popiah instead if you want the filling without the deep-fried wrapper. Big calorie saving.
Stick to two rolls and make them the only fried thing on the table.
Let them drain on the paper and skip dunking them in extra sweet chilli sauce.

faq.q: How many calories in a fried spring roll?
faq.a: About 130 calories each, so two rolls is around 260. The filling is light, but the deep-fried wrapper absorbs a lot of oil, which is where most of the calories come from.

faq.q: Are spring rolls or popiah lighter?
faq.a: Fresh popiah is much lighter because the skin is soft and not fried. A fried spring roll has a similar filling but the deep-fried wrapper can double the calories. Choose popiah if you are watching it.

faq.q: Are spring rolls bad for weight loss?
faq.a: They are not ideal because they are deep-fried, but two as part of a balanced order are fine. The trap is treating them as a vegetable dish. Count them as the fried item they are.

foods.name: Steamed Pork Ribs
foods.metaDescription: A plate of dim sum steamed pork ribs is about 200 calories. The black bean spare ribs broken down, with macros and why they are a smart order.
foods.summary: Bite-sized pork ribs steamed in garlic and black bean sauce. High protein, no deep frying, one of the smarter picks.
foods.answer: A small plate of dim sum steamed pork ribs (the bite-sized spare ribs in black bean and garlic sauce) is about 200 calories. They are steamed, not fried, and they are genuinely meat, so for the calories you get a solid hit of protein. The main thing to watch is the fattier cuts and the oil in the sauce, but overall this is one of the better-value orders.
realTalk: Steamed pork ribs are an underrated smart order bro. No batter, no deep frying, just bite-sized pork steamed in garlic and black bean sauce. A small plate is around 200 calories and gives you a proper 16g of protein. That ratio is good, the kind of thing you want more of when you are trying to stay full on fewer calories.

The only catch is the cut. These are usually fatty rib pieces, so there is fat marbled in, and the sauce has a bit of oil. But compared to a fried taro puff or a sweet bun, this is the kind of plate you can lean on. Order this and the steamed dumplings, go easy on the fried trolley, and you have eaten well.
lighter: Make this one of your protein anchors alongside har gao and siew mai.
Pick the meatier pieces over the pure fat-and-bone ones if you are choosing off the plate.
Spoon the ribs out and leave most of the pooled oil behind in the dish.

faq.q: Are steamed pork ribs a good dim sum choice?
faq.a: Yes, one of the better ones. They are steamed rather than fried and they are real meat, giving about 16g of protein for roughly 200 calories a plate. That is a strong ratio for dim sum.

faq.q: Why are dim sum pork ribs fatty?
faq.a: They use small, fattier rib cuts so the meat stays tender when steamed. The fat marbling plus a little oil in the black bean sauce is where most of the calories sit, but it is still a lean order by dim sum standards.

faq.q: How much protein is in dim sum pork ribs?
faq.a: About 16g per small plate, almost all from the pork. Combined with the low carbs, that makes steamed ribs one of the more protein-dense things on the trolley.

foods.name: Bubble Tea (Pearl Milk Tea)
foods.metaDescription: A medium bubble tea is around 380 calories, mostly from the pearls and sugar. Here is the breakdown and how to order it lighter.
foods.summary: Milk tea plus chewy tapioca pearls and a lot of sugar, easily 380 calories a cup.
foods.answer: A medium 500ml bubble tea with full sugar and pearls lands around 380 calories. The pearls alone are about 150 of that, and the sugar syrup adds another 150 or so before the milk and creamer even come in. Push it to a large with extra toppings and you are at 500 plus.
realTalk: Bro, bubble tea is not a drink, it is a dessert you sip through a fat straw. The tea part is almost nothing. It is the pearls and the sugar that do all the damage. Those chewy pearls are pure starch soaked in syrup, so a normal scoop is 150 calories just sitting at the bottom of your cup.

Then they ask you sugar level and most people just say normal, which is full sugar lah. Full sugar plus pearls plus non dairy creamer and you drank a small meal. One a day, every day, that is 2660 calories a week you did not chew. No wonder the weight does not move.
lighter: Order 30 percent sugar or less, the tea still tastes sweet trust me
Skip the pearls or swap to grass jelly, saves you 100 plus calories
Go small instead of large, that alone cuts off 100 to 150 calories

faq.q: How many calories in a bubble tea?
faq.a: A medium 500ml with pearls and full sugar is around 380 calories. Small with less sugar can drop to 150, large with extra toppings climbs past 500.

faq.q: Are the pearls the worst part?
faq.a: Pretty much. The tapioca pearls add about 150 calories on their own, all starch. Cut the pearls and you cut the biggest chunk.

faq.q: Can I drink bubble tea and still lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, if you fit it in your budget. Go small, 30 percent sugar, no pearls and it is just a treat, not a meal you drank by accident.

foods.name: Milo Dinosaur
foods.metaDescription: A Milo Dinosaur is roughly 340 calories, more sugar than a can of Coke. Here is what is inside and how to make it lighter.
foods.summary: Iced Milo with condensed milk and a heap of dry Milo dumped on top, about 340 calories.
foods.answer: A Milo Dinosaur runs around 340 calories a glass, sometimes more depending on how heavy the hand was with the condensed milk. The base iced Milo is already sweet, then they pile undissolved Milo powder on top, which is just more sugar and malt. That heap alone can be 50 to 80 calories of pure powder.
realTalk: Milo Dinosaur is iced Milo that got greedy. Normal Milo ais is already milky and sweet, then someone decided to bury it under a small mountain of dry Milo powder. That powder is not free, bro. It is sugar and malt, and the heap on top can add 60 odd calories before it even melts into your drink.

People think because it is Milo it is healthy, like some sports drink. Nah. With condensed milk it can hit 40 to 50 grams of sugar, more than a can of Coke. It is a tasty treat, no shame, but treat it like dessert, not a daily energy boost.
lighter: Ask for less condensed milk, that is where most of the calories hide
Skip the dry Milo topping, saves you 50 to 80 calories instantly
Use evaporated milk instead of condensed, lighter but still creamy

faq.q: How many calories in a Milo Dinosaur?
faq.a: Around 340 calories a glass. The dry Milo heap and the condensed milk are the heavy hitters.

faq.q: Is Milo Dinosaur healthy?
faq.a: Not really. It is tasty but it can carry more sugar than a can of Coke. Drink it as a treat, not a daily thing.

faq.q: What is the difference between Milo ais and Milo Dinosaur?
faq.a: Milo ais is just iced Milo. The Dinosaur adds a big heap of undissolved Milo powder on top, which is extra sugar and calories.

foods.name: Kopi O
foods.metaDescription: Kopi O is only about 60 calories, all from the sugar. Here is why it is one of the lightest drinks at the kopitiam.
foods.summary: Black coffee with sugar, no milk, so it is only about 60 calories from the sugar.
foods.answer: Kopi O is black coffee with sugar and no milk, so it clocks in at roughly 60 calories a glass, all from the sugar they stir in. The coffee itself is basically zero. Order it kosong with no sugar and you are looking at 5 calories, basically free.
realTalk: Kopi O is one of the few kopitiam drinks that will not wreck you. No milk, no condensed milk, just black coffee and some sugar. That sugar is the only thing adding calories, around 55 to 60 of them, and you can kill even that by ordering kosong.

This is the move if you love your kopitiam habit but want to keep the calories tiny. Compare kopi O at 60 calories to a normal kopi with condensed milk at 140 plus. Same caffeine hit, less than half the damage. Easy swap lah.
lighter: Order kopi O kosong (no sugar) and it drops to about 5 calories
Ask for kurang manis (less sweet) to halve the sugar
Drink it hot instead of iced, you tend to sip slower and order less sugar

faq.q: How many calories in kopi O?
faq.a: About 60 calories a glass, almost all of it from the sugar. Kosong with no sugar is just 5.

faq.q: Is kopi O good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the lightest drinks at the kopitiam. No milk means almost no calories beyond the sugar you add.

faq.q: What is the difference between kopi O and kopi C?
faq.a: Kopi O is black with sugar, no milk, around 60 calories. Kopi C adds evaporated milk and lands closer to 110.

foods.name: Teh Ais
foods.metaDescription: A glass of teh ais is about 150 calories. Here is where the sugar hides and how to order it lighter.
foods.summary: Iced milk tea with condensed milk and sugar, around 150 calories a glass.
foods.answer: A standard glass of teh ais is about 150 calories. The tea is nothing, but the condensed milk and added sugar do all the work, easily 120 of those calories combined. Order it teh o ais (no milk) and it drops to around 60.
realTalk: Bro that teh ais you order without thinking? Condensed milk plus sugar, that is 150 calories of pure sweet before you even touch food. The tea leaves contribute basically nothing, it is the sweetened condensed milk that turns it into a calorie drink.

Three teh ais a day is a meal you drank by accident, around 450 calories you did not even chew. If you are trying to lose weight and cannot figure out why it is stuck, count your drinks first. Most people are shocked when they add it up.
lighter: Order teh o ais (no milk) to cut about 90 calories
Ask for kurang manis to slash the sugar
Switch to teh o ais limau, lime tea with sugar only, light and refreshing

faq.q: How many calories in teh ais?
faq.a: About 150 calories a standard glass, mostly from condensed milk and sugar.

faq.q: Is teh ais bad for weight loss?
faq.a: Not on its own, but two or three a day adds up to a hidden meal. Watch the count or switch to teh o ais.

faq.q: Is teh o ais lighter?
faq.a: Yes, much. No condensed milk means around 60 calories instead of 150.

foods.name: Teh C
foods.metaDescription: Teh C is around 130 calories, made with evaporated milk and sugar. Here is how it compares to teh ais and how to lighten it.
foods.summary: Tea with evaporated milk and sugar, about 130 calories, slightly lighter than teh ais.
foods.answer: Teh C is tea made with evaporated milk instead of condensed, plus sugar, landing around 130 calories a glass. The evaporated milk is unsweetened, so the sweetness comes from the sugar they add separately. That makes it a touch lighter than teh ais if you control the sugar.
realTalk: Teh C is the tea with evaporated milk, the C is for Carnation, the old milk brand. Because the milk is unsweetened, you have more control here. The sugar is added on the side, so kurang manis actually makes a real dent, unlike condensed milk where the sweet is baked in.

Standard teh C is about 130 calories, so a little lighter than teh ais. Not a huge difference, but if you drink a few a day it adds up in your favour. Order it kosong, just tea and evaporated milk with no sugar, and you are down around 70.
lighter: Order kurang manis, the sugar is added separately so this really helps
Go kosong (no sugar) and rely on the milk for body, around 70 calories
Switch to teh o limau for a sugar-only lime tea that feels lighter

faq.q: How many calories in teh C?
faq.a: Around 130 calories a glass with sugar. Kosong (no sugar) drops to about 70.

faq.q: Is teh C healthier than teh ais?
faq.a: Slightly. Evaporated milk is unsweetened, so you control the sugar yourself. Order kurang manis and it beats teh ais.

faq.q: What does the C in teh C mean?
faq.a: It stands for Carnation, the evaporated milk brand. Teh C is tea with evaporated milk.

foods.name: Soya Cincau (Michael Jackson)
foods.metaDescription: Soya cincau, the Michael Jackson drink, is around 200 calories. Here is what is inside and how to keep it light.
foods.summary: Sweet soya milk with grass jelly, the black-and-white Michael Jackson, about 200 calories.
foods.answer: Soya cincau, nicknamed Michael Jackson for the black grass jelly in white soya milk, runs around 200 calories a glass. The soya milk is usually sweetened and the grass jelly comes with sugar syrup, so most of the calories are sugar. The soya itself gives you a little protein, around 6 grams.
realTalk: Michael Jackson, black and white, get it? Grass jelly sitting in soya milk. It sounds healthy because soya, but the soya milk at most stalls is sweetened heavily and the cincau is soaked in sugar syrup. So you are drinking maybe 30 grams of sugar in a glass.

It is not the worst choice lah, at least you get a bit of protein from the soya, around 6 grams. But do not kid yourself that it is a health drink. Ask for the unsweetened soya version if they have it and you cut a big chunk of the calories straight away.
lighter: Ask for unsweetened or less-sweet soya milk if available
Order it without extra sugar syrup on the cincau
Have it as a snack replacement, not on top of a full meal

faq.q: How many calories in soya cincau?
faq.a: About 200 calories a glass. Most of it is sugar from the sweetened soya and the cincau syrup.

faq.q: Why is it called Michael Jackson?
faq.a: Because of the look, black grass jelly in white soya milk. Black and white, get it.

faq.q: Is soya cincau healthy?
faq.a: It has a little protein from the soya, but it is usually loaded with sugar. Order unsweetened soya to make it genuinely lighter.

foods.name: Limau Ais
foods.metaDescription: Limau ais is about 100 calories, all from sugar since there is no milk. Here is how to order it even lighter.
foods.summary: Iced lime juice with sugar, no milk, around 100 calories from the sugar.
foods.answer: Limau ais is iced lime with sugar, around 100 calories a glass, every one of them from the sugar syrup. There is no milk and no fat, so it is genuinely one of the lighter mamak drinks. Ask for less sugar and it drops fast.
realTalk: Limau ais is just lime, water, ice and sugar. No milk, no cream, nothing fatty. The only calories come from the sugar syrup they squeeze in, around 100 worth. Compared to a teh ais or a Milo, this is a featherweight.

The catch is some stalls go heavy on the sugar to balance the sour, so it can creep higher than you think. Just say kurang manis. The lime keeps it refreshing even with way less sugar, so you barely notice the difference.
lighter: Order kurang manis, the lime still tastes great with half the sugar
Ask for plain lime soda water with a tiny bit of sugar instead
Skip the sugar fully for limau ais kosong, basically 10 calories

faq.q: How many calories in limau ais?
faq.a: About 100 calories a glass, all from the sugar. No milk means no fat calories.

faq.q: Is limau ais good for dieting?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the lighter mamak drinks. Order kurang manis and it is barely 55 calories.

faq.q: Is limau ais just lime juice?
faq.a: Lime juice, water, ice and sugar. The sugar is the only real calorie source.

foods.name: Jus Tembikai (Watermelon Juice)
foods.metaDescription: Watermelon juice is around 130 calories, more than you think once the stall adds sugar. Here is the breakdown.
foods.summary: Blended watermelon juice, around 130 calories, higher when the stall adds sugar syrup.
foods.answer: A glass of jus tembikai is roughly 130 calories. Watermelon is mostly water so plain it would be light, but most stalls add sugar syrup even though the fruit is already sweet. That added sugar is what pushes it up. Pure watermelon blended with nothing added would be closer to 90.
realTalk: Watermelon is like 90 percent water, so you would think jus tembikai is basically free. Problem is the stall almost always adds sugar syrup, even when the fruit is already sweet enough. That habit turns a light fruit juice into a 130 calorie glass.

It is still better than a Milo Dinosaur lah, you do get actual fruit. But juicing strips the fibre, so you lose the part that keeps you full. Honestly eating a wedge of real watermelon beats drinking it, fewer calories and you actually chew something.
lighter: Ask for no added sugar, the watermelon is sweet enough already
Request it blended with just ice, no syrup
Eat a wedge of real watermelon instead, more filling and fewer calories

faq.q: How many calories in watermelon juice?
faq.a: About 130 calories a glass at most stalls. No added sugar version is closer to 90.

faq.q: Is watermelon juice healthy?
faq.a: It has real fruit, but juicing removes the fibre and stalls add sugar. Eating the fruit is better.

faq.q: Why does jus tembikai have so many calories?
faq.a: The watermelon itself is light. The added sugar syrup is what pushes it up.

foods.name: Asam Boi Drink
foods.metaDescription: Asam boi drink is around 110 calories, mostly sugar despite the sour kick. Here is what is really in that glass.
foods.summary: Sour plum drink, usually lime plus asam boi and sugar, around 110 calories.
foods.answer: An asam boi drink is roughly 110 calories a glass. The sour plum and lime trick your tongue into thinking it is not sweet, but stalls add plenty of sugar to balance the sour, plus the preserved plums themselves carry sugar and salt. So the tangy taste hides a fair bit of sugar.
realTalk: Asam boi is the sour plum drink, usually lime and water with those preserved plums dropped in. The sour really fools you, it does not taste sweet so people assume it is light. But the stall adds sugar to balance the sour bite, and the plums are preserved in sugar and salt to begin with.

So you sip something tangy and refreshing and feel virtuous, meanwhile it is around 110 calories of mostly sugar. Not a disaster, but not the diet hero you think it is. Ask for kurang manis and the asam boi flavour still comes through strong.
lighter: Order kurang manis, the sour plum still gives plenty of flavour
Ask for fewer plums and less syrup
Add more plain water or ice to dilute the sugar hit

faq.q: How many calories in an asam boi drink?
faq.a: Around 110 calories a glass. The sour taste hides a decent amount of sugar.

faq.q: Is asam boi drink healthy?
faq.a: It is light-ish but not sugar-free. The plums and added syrup carry sugar despite the sour flavour.

faq.q: Why does asam boi taste sour but still have sugar?
faq.a: Stalls add sugar to balance the sour plum, so the tangy taste masks the sweetness.

foods.name: Chrysanthemum Tea (Teh Krisan)
foods.metaDescription: Chrysanthemum tea is about 90 calories, light unless the stall loads the sugar. Here is how to keep it clean.
foods.summary: Brewed chrysanthemum flower tea with sugar, around 90 calories, light if you skip the syrup.
foods.answer: Teh krisan, chrysanthemum tea, is around 90 calories a glass. The flower brew itself has almost no calories, so everything you are drinking is the sugar they add. Order it without sugar and it is basically a free drink, close to zero.
realTalk: Chrysanthemum tea is one of those drinks people order thinking it is healthy, and you know what, the base actually is. It is just brewed flowers, no calories at all. The only reason it shows up at 90 calories is the sugar or rock sugar they stir in.

So this one is fully in your control. Kosong, no sugar, and you are drinking something that is genuinely close to zero calories with a nice floral taste. If you want a sweet mamak drink that will not hurt you, this is one of the smartest picks on the menu.
lighter: Order it kosong (no sugar), drops to nearly zero calories
Ask for kurang manis if you still want a bit of sweetness
Drink it hot, you tend to need less sugar to enjoy it

faq.q: How many calories in chrysanthemum tea?
faq.a: About 90 calories a glass with sugar. Without sugar it is nearly zero.

faq.q: Is chrysanthemum tea good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes, the brew itself has no calories. Order it kosong and it is one of the lightest drinks around.

faq.q: Does teh krisan have caffeine?
faq.a: No, it is a flower tea, not a real tea leaf, so it is naturally caffeine-free.

foods.name: Neslo Ais (Nescafe + Milo)
foods.metaDescription: Neslo ais is around 250 calories, Nescafe plus Milo plus condensed milk. Here is what is in the glass.
foods.summary: Nescafe and Milo mixed together with condensed milk, around 250 calories.
foods.answer: Neslo ais is Nescafe plus Milo in one glass, usually with condensed milk, landing around 250 calories. You are basically stacking a coffee drink and a chocolate malt drink together, so the calories add up faster than either one alone. The condensed milk is the heaviest part.
realTalk: Neslo is what happens when you cannot decide between coffee and Milo, so you order both in one glass. Nes for Nescafe, lo for Milo. Sounds genius until you realise you just combined two sweet drinks into one, plus condensed milk on top.

That stacking is why it hits around 250 calories, heavier than a plain Milo ais or a kopi. It is a tasty kaw kaw drink, no doubt, but treat it like the indulgence it is. Ask for less condensed milk and you can knock 50 odd calories off without losing the flavour.
lighter: Ask for less condensed milk, the biggest calorie cut
Order it kurang manis to control the sugar
Use evaporated milk instead of condensed for a lighter version

faq.q: How many calories in neslo ais?
faq.a: Around 250 calories a glass. Combining Nescafe and Milo with condensed milk stacks it up.

faq.q: What is neslo?
faq.a: Nescafe plus Milo mixed in one glass. Nes from Nescafe, lo from Milo.

faq.q: Is neslo worse than Milo ais?
faq.a: A bit heavier, since you add coffee and often more condensed milk. Around 250 versus 200 for plain Milo ais.

foods.name: Three Layer Tea (Teh C Peng Special)
foods.metaDescription: Three layer tea is around 210 calories, that gula melaka bottom layer is pure sugar. Here is the breakdown.
foods.summary: Teh C with a gula melaka palm sugar bottom layer, around 210 calories.
foods.answer: Three layer tea, or teh C peng special, is around 210 calories a glass. It is teh C with a thick layer of gula melaka palm sugar syrup sitting at the bottom, which is where the three layers come from. That gula melaka layer is basically concentrated sugar, so it pushes the calories well above a normal teh C.
realTalk: Three layer tea looks fancy, the gula melaka sinks to the bottom, evaporated milk in the middle, tea on top. Looks like art. But that beautiful bottom layer is a thick pour of palm sugar syrup, and that is the whole reason it costs more calories than a plain teh C.

You are looking at around 210 calories, mostly because of that gula melaka. It does taste amazing, the palm sugar gives it that deep caramel thing. Just know it is a sweeter, heavier cousin of teh C, so order it as a treat and not your everyday drink lah.
lighter: Ask for less gula melaka, the bottom layer is the calorie bomb
Order a plain teh C kurang manis instead for everyday drinking
Share a glass if you just want a taste of the palm sugar

faq.q: How many calories in three layer tea?
faq.a: Around 210 calories a glass. The gula melaka bottom layer is the main reason it is high.

faq.q: What are the three layers?
faq.a: Gula melaka syrup at the bottom, evaporated milk in the middle, tea on top. It is a fancy teh C.

faq.q: Is three layer tea worse than teh C?
faq.a: Yes, the extra gula melaka adds about 80 calories over a normal teh C.

foods.name: Horlicks Ais
foods.metaDescription: Horlicks ais is around 230 calories, malty and sweet with condensed milk. Here is what is really in the glass.
foods.summary: Iced malted Horlicks drink with condensed milk, around 230 calories.
foods.answer: A glass of Horlicks ais is roughly 230 calories. The Horlicks malt powder is already sweet and carries calories on its own, then the kopitiam adds condensed milk on top. So like Milo, the powder plus condensed milk combo is what makes it a heavier drink than people expect.
realTalk: Horlicks ais tastes like malted childhood, that creamy biscuit kind of flavour. People order it thinking it is a wholesome malt drink, like something good for you. The powder is malt and sugar, and at the kopitiam they sweeten it further with condensed milk.

That combo lands it around 230 calories, right up there with Milo ais. It is not evil, you do get a bit of protein from the malt and milk, around 6 grams. But it is a sweet treat drink, not a health tonic. Ask for less condensed milk if you want to enjoy it more often.
lighter: Ask for less condensed milk to cut the heaviest part
Order it kurang manis so they ease off the sugar
Use fresh or evaporated milk instead of condensed

faq.q: How many calories in Horlicks ais?
faq.a: Around 230 calories a glass. The malt powder and condensed milk together do most of it.

faq.q: Is Horlicks ais healthy?
faq.a: It has a little protein, but it is mostly malt and sugar. Treat it as a sweet drink, not a health tonic.

faq.q: Is Horlicks ais like Milo ais?
faq.a: Very similar in calories, around 230. Both are malt powders sweetened with condensed milk.

foods.name: Ais Krim Potong
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in ais krim potong? About 110 per stick. The coconut and red bean ones are the heavier ones. Real numbers inside.
foods.summary: Ais krim potong is around 110 calories a stick. Cheap, cold, and not a diet disaster if you stop at one.
foods.answer: One stick of ais krim potong is around 110 calories. The coconut milk and sugar base does most of the damage, plus whatever they pack in like red bean, corn, or yam. It is way lighter than a scoop of premium ice cream, so as a hot-day treat it is honestly fine.
realTalk: Bro this is the budget dessert champion. RM1 to RM2 a stick, ice cold, and only about 110 calories. Compared to a tub of Haagen-Dazs hitting 250 calories per half cup, the humble potong is basically a health food in disguise.

The trap is not one stick, it is finishing five because they are cheap and the uncle is right there. Five sticks is 550 calories, which is a whole proper meal gone on flavoured ice. Eat one, enjoy it slow, walk away.
lighter: Stick to one stick and actually taste it instead of inhaling it
Pick fruit-based flavours over the heavy coconut or red bean ones to shave a few calories
Have it after a high-protein meal so you are already full and not tempted to grab three

faq.q: Is ais krim potong healthier than normal ice cream?
faq.a: Calorie-wise yes. A stick is about 110 calories versus 200 to 250 for a scoop of rich ice cream. It is mostly water and ice so the volume tricks your brain into feeling satisfied.

faq.q: Which flavour has the most calories?
faq.a: The coconut and red bean ones tend to be heaviest because of the extra santan and starchy beans. Plain fruit flavours sit a bit lower.

faq.q: Can I eat ais krim potong while losing weight?
faq.a: Yes, easily. One stick at 110 calories fits into almost any day. Just do not turn it into a five-stick session.

variants.name: Coconut potong
variants.note: extra santan pushes it slightly higher

variants.name: Red bean potong
variants.note: the beans add starch and sugar

foods.name: Tau Fu Fah (Soy Bean Pudding)
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in tau fu fah? A bowl with syrup is about 150. Plain it drops near 60. The sugar syrup is the real story.
foods.summary: Tau fu fah is around 150 calories a bowl with syrup. The tofu is cheap, the syrup is the calories.
foods.answer: A bowl of tau fu fah with sugar syrup is about 150 calories. The silky soy pudding itself is barely 60 calories and gives you around 5g of protein, which is great. Almost everything else is that sweet gula syrup they drown it in.
realTalk: Here is the funny part. The actual tau fu fah, the silky soy custard, is one of the lightest desserts you can order at maybe 60 calories. It is soy, so you even get a bit of protein out of it. Then the uncle pours half a cup of sugar syrup over it and suddenly it is 150.

So this one is fully in your control. Ask for less syrup, or syrup on the side, and you are eating a 70 to 90 calorie dessert with real protein. Bro that is basically a snack that loves you back. Most people just never think to ask.
lighter: Ask for syrup on the side and pour your own, you will use way less
Choose plain ginger syrup over thick gula melaka syrup to cut sugar
Skip extra toppings like grass jelly or pearls that quietly add 50 to 80 calories

faq.q: Is tau fu fah good for weight loss?
faq.a: The pudding part is excellent. It is low calorie, high in water, and gives you about 5g of protein. The only catch is the sugar syrup, so control that and it is one of the best dessert choices going.

faq.q: How many calories without syrup?
faq.a: Plain tau fu fah is only around 60 to 65 calories a bowl. The syrup is what roughly doubles it.

faq.q: Does tau fu fah have protein?
faq.a: Yes, around 5g per bowl since it is made from soy milk. That is unusually high for a dessert.

variants.name: With gula melaka syrup
variants.note: thicker syrup, a touch more sugar

foods.name: Bubur Pulut Hitam
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in bubur pulut hitam? About 290 a bowl. The black rice looks healthy but the santan hides 100+ calories.
foods.summary: Bubur pulut hitam is around 290 calories a bowl. Black rice sounds healthy, the coconut milk says otherwise.
foods.answer: A bowl of bubur pulut hitam is about 290 calories. The black glutinous rice and sugar make up most of it, and then the coconut milk drizzle on top adds roughly 100 calories on its own. It tastes like a healthy dessert but that santan is doing real work.
realTalk: Pulut hitam tastes like a healthy dessert because it is black rice, full of fibre and antioxidants, but bro that santan they drown it in is where 100 plus calories are hiding. The rice and sugar already put you around 190, then the coconut milk topping shoves you to 290.

It is not a bad dessert at all. You actually get some fibre and a bit of protein out of it. Just respect that it is a 290 calorie bowl and not the free health food it pretends to be. If you want it lighter, the move is simply less santan on top.
lighter: Ask for less coconut milk on top, that alone saves around 80 to 100 calories
Have a smaller bowl, half a portion is a satisfying 145 calories
Skip the extra scoop of sugar, the rice is already sweetened in the pot

faq.q: Is bubur pulut hitam healthy?
faq.a: It has good things going for it, black rice gives you fibre and antioxidants. But at 290 calories a bowl, mostly from coconut milk and sugar, treat it as a dessert and not a free pass.

faq.q: Why is pulut hitam so high in calories?
faq.a: The coconut milk is the main reason. That topping alone is around 100 calories. Glutinous rice and palm sugar do the rest.

faq.q: Can I eat pulut hitam on a diet?
faq.a: Yes, just account for it. Ask for less santan and keep the portion reasonable and a bowl fits fine into a normal day.

variants.name: Light santan
variants.note: ask them to go easy on the coconut milk

foods.name: Cheng Tng
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in cheng tng? About 160 a bowl. A clear sweet soup with almost no fat, one of the lighter desserts going.
foods.summary: Cheng tng is around 160 calories a bowl. Clear, light, almost no fat, just watch the sugar syrup.
foods.answer: A bowl of cheng tng is about 160 calories. It is a clear sweet soup loaded with longan, barley, white fungus and dried fruits, so there is basically no fat. Almost all the calories come from the sugar syrup it sits in.
realTalk: Cheng tng is one of the genuinely smart dessert orders. No coconut milk, no fried anything, no glutinous rice. Just a clear broth with barley, longan, gingko and a few dried bits floating around. At 160 calories with almost zero fat, this is about as light as a sweet bowl gets.

The only thing to watch is the sugar level in the syrup. Some stalls go heavy and you can drink it without realising. Ask for less sweet, get the same shiok experience for maybe 110 calories, and walk away feeling like you cheated the system.
lighter: Order it less sweet, the syrup is the only real calorie source
Have it cold without extra sugar syrup added at the end
Eat the solid bits and leave half the syrup in the bowl

faq.q: Is cheng tng a good dessert for dieting?
faq.a: One of the best. At 160 calories with basically no fat, it beats almost every coconut milk or fried dessert. Just ask for less sugar and it gets even better.

faq.q: Does cheng tng have fat?
faq.a: Almost none. It is a clear soup with dried fruits and barley, so the fat is close to zero. The calories are mostly sugar.

faq.q: How do I make cheng tng lighter?
faq.a: Order it less sweet or leave some of the syrup behind. The solids barely add up, so cutting syrup is where you save.

foods.name: Mango Sticky Rice (Pulut Mangga)
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in mango sticky rice? About 380 a plate. The glutinous rice and coconut sauce make this a heavy one.
foods.summary: Mango sticky rice is around 380 calories a plate. Tastes like fruit, eats like a carb bomb.
foods.answer: A plate of mango sticky rice is about 380 calories. The glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk is the bulk of it, the mango adds natural sugar, and then they pour more salted coconut sauce on top. It is delicious but it is closer to a meal than a light snack.
realTalk: Bro do not let the mango fool you into thinking this is a fruit dessert. The fruit is maybe 60 calories of the whole thing. The real heavyweight is the glutinous rice, which they cook in coconut milk and sugar, then top with even more santan sauce. That is how you get to 380.

This is one of the heavier desserts on the menu, easily matching a small meal. It is worth it once in a while because it is genuinely shiok, just do not pretend it is light because there is fruit on the plate. Share it with someone and you both walk away happy at 190 each.
lighter: Split one plate between two people, instant halving to 190 calories
Eat more of the mango and less of the rice, the fruit is the light part
Ask for the coconut sauce on the side and use just a little

faq.q: Is mango sticky rice fattening?
faq.a: It is calorie dense at around 380 a plate, mostly from coconut glutinous rice. The mango is the small part. Enjoy it occasionally and account for it like a small meal.

faq.q: Why is mango sticky rice so high in calories?
faq.a: Glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk plus a santan sauce on top. That combination is rich and sugary. The mango itself only adds about 40 calories.

faq.q: Can I eat mango sticky rice on a diet?
faq.a: Yes, but treat it like a meal-sized treat. Split a plate or eat half and you keep it around 190 calories.

variants.name: Extra mango less rice
variants.note: swap some heavy rice for fruit

foods.name: Pengat Pisang
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in pengat pisang? About 280 a bowl. Banana sounds healthy but coconut milk and gula melaka run the show.
foods.summary: Pengat pisang is around 280 calories a bowl. Banana, coconut milk and palm sugar, a rich combo.
foods.answer: A bowl of pengat pisang is about 280 calories. It is bananas stewed in coconut milk and gula melaka, so the fruit is healthy but the santan and palm sugar are where the calories live. Warm, sweet, and heavier than it looks.
realTalk: Pengat pisang sounds innocent, it is just banana right. But the banana gets simmered in a pool of coconut milk and gula melaka until it is basically a sweet santan stew. The fruit contributes maybe 90 calories, the coconut milk and palm sugar bring the rest up to 280.

It is a proper comfort dessert, warm and rich, the kind of thing you want during puasa or a rainy evening. Nothing wrong with it, just know it is a 280 calorie bowl and not a guilt-free banana snack. Lighter santan is the easiest way to trim it down.
lighter: Ask for less coconut milk to cut around 70 calories
Use ripe banana sweetness and request less added gula melaka
Have a smaller bowl, half a portion is a cosy 140 calories

faq.q: Is pengat pisang healthy?
faq.a: The banana gives you potassium and fibre, but the dish overall is around 280 calories because of coconut milk and palm sugar. Treat it as a dessert, not a fruit serving.

faq.q: What makes pengat pisang high in calories?
faq.a: Coconut milk and gula melaka. The banana is the light part at around 90 calories. The santan and sugar push it up to 280.

faq.q: Can I eat pengat pisang and still lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, just budget for it. Ask for less santan and keep the bowl small and it fits into a normal day fine.

variants.name: Light santan
variants.note: go easy on the coconut milk

foods.name: Kuih Bingka Ubi (Baked Tapioca Cake)
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in kuih bingka ubi? About 230 a slice. Dense baked tapioca with coconut milk, heavier than it looks.
foods.summary: Kuih bingka ubi is around 230 calories a slice. Small piece, dense and rich, do not be fooled by the size.
foods.answer: One slice of kuih bingka ubi is about 230 calories. It is grated tapioca baked with coconut milk, sugar and egg into a dense chewy cake. Because it is so compact, even a small slice carries more calories than you would guess.
realTalk: This one is sneaky because the slice is small but it is dense as a brick. Grated cassava, coconut milk, sugar and egg all baked down into a chewy block. There is no air in there, no fluff, just packed starch and santan. So a modest looking piece is already around 230 calories.

It is one of those kuih where two slices feel like nothing on the plate but you just ate 460 calories standing at the pasar. Bro that is a meal. Enjoy one slice with your kopi and call it done, the second slice is the one that gets people.
lighter: Stick to one slice, the density means a small piece is already plenty
Pair it with kopi kosong instead of a sweet drink to keep total sugar down
Share a slab so you taste it without committing to a full slice

faq.q: Why is kuih bingka ubi so calorie dense?
faq.a: It is baked tapioca with coconut milk and sugar, with almost no air in it. That makes even a small slice around 230 calories. The density is the catch.

faq.q: Is bingka ubi worse than other kuih?
faq.a: It is on the heavier side because of the coconut milk and packed starch. A single slice is fine, the problem is how easy it is to grab two or three.

faq.q: Can I eat bingka ubi on a diet?
faq.a: Yes, one slice fits into a normal day. Just count it properly at around 230 calories and resist the second piece.

foods.name: Ais Krim Goreng (Fried Ice Cream)
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in fried ice cream? About 360 a piece. Ice cream wrapped in batter and deep fried, exactly as heavy as it sounds.
foods.summary: Ais krim goreng is around 360 calories a piece. Deep fried ice cream is double trouble, fat plus sugar.
foods.answer: One piece of ais krim goreng is about 360 calories. You take a scoop of ice cream, wrap it in batter or breadcrumbs, and deep fry it. So you get the sugar and fat of ice cream plus the oil and carbs of frying. It is rich on rich.
realTalk: This is dessert showing off. Take ice cream, which is already sugar and cream, then coat it and dunk it in hot oil so it picks up another layer of fat and crunch. The frying alone adds serious calories on top of the ice cream inside. That is how a single ball lands at around 360.

Honestly it is delicious and a fun thing to order once in a blue moon. Just do not kid yourself, this is the heaviest dessert in the lineup at 18g of fat a piece. Bro one of these is basically half a burger in dessert form. Share it, or have one and skip the second drink.
lighter: Share one piece, half is a more reasonable 180 calories
Skip the chocolate or caramel drizzle they love to add on top
Have it as the whole dessert, do not pair it with another sweet drink

faq.q: Is fried ice cream the worst dessert calorie-wise?
faq.a: It is up there. At around 360 calories with 18g of fat per piece, it combines the sugar of ice cream with the oil of deep frying. One of the heaviest on the dessert menu.

faq.q: Why is ais krim goreng so high in fat?
faq.a: Because you are deep frying cream. The ice cream already has fat, then the batter soaks up oil during frying, stacking it to around 18g per piece.

faq.q: Can I fit fried ice cream into a diet?
faq.a: Occasionally, yes, if you budget for it like a small meal. Sharing one piece is the easiest way to enjoy it without the full 360 calorie hit.

variants.name: With chocolate drizzle
variants.note: the topping adds sugar and fat

foods.name: Ramly Burger
foods.metaDescription: A Ramly burger special is around 600 calories. The egg wrap, margarine and sauces turn one small patty into a heavy supper. Full breakdown.
foods.summary: One special is about 600 calories. The egg blanket and margarine do the damage, not the patty.
foods.answer: A Ramly burger special is around 600 calories for the whole thing (about 250g). The seasoned patty itself is maybe 200 of that. The rest is the folded egg wrap, the heavy slap of margarine on the griddle, the bun, and the squeeze of mayo, chilli and Maggi sauce. That is 25g protein, 45g carbs and 35g fat.
realTalk: The Ramly special is a magic trick bro. That folded egg blanket plus a heavy squeeze of margarine, mayo, chilli and Maggi sauce turns one small patty into a 600 calorie supper-by-the-roadside. The patty alone is innocent. It is everything the abang piles on top that gets you.

Watch the guy cook it next time. He drowns the griddle in margarine, fries the egg in it, then hits the bun with more. None of that is free. If you order daging double special with cheese you are easily past 800, and that is supper on top of whatever you already ate for dinner lah.
lighter: Order the biasa (plain) instead of the special. Skipping the egg wrap and extra sauces cuts a big chunk straight away.
Ask for less margarine and go easy on the mayo. Just that alone saves you 100 plus calories.
Make it the meal, not the supper after the meal. A 600 calorie burger is fine if it replaces dinner, not if it follows it.

faq.q: How many calories in a Ramly burger special?
faq.a: Around 600 calories for the full special. The patty is only about 200 of that. The egg wrap, margarine and sauces are where the rest comes from.

faq.q: Is the chicken (ayam) one lower than the beef?
faq.a: Slightly, maybe 30 to 50 calories less, but not enough to matter. The egg, margarine and sauces are the same either way, so do not pick ayam thinking it is the light option.

faq.q: How do I make a Ramly burger less fattening?
faq.a: Order biasa instead of special to skip the egg wrap, tell the abang less margarine, and go easy on the mayo. That can knock off 150 to 200 calories.

variants.name: Ramly ayam special
variants.note: Chicken patty version of the special

foods.name: Roti John
foods.metaDescription: A whole roti john is around 650 calories. Egg and minced meat fried onto a long bun, then drizzled with sauce. Full breakdown.
foods.summary: One whole roti john is about 650 calories. The bread soaks up the egg and oil like a sponge.
foods.answer: A whole roti john runs about 650 calories. It is a long bun split open, smeared with an egg and minced meat mix, then pressed face down onto an oily griddle so the bread fries and soaks everything up. Add the chilli and mayo drizzle on top and you get roughly 28g protein, 60g carbs and 33g fat. A loaded mutton version can push past 850.
realTalk: Roti john looks healthy because there is egg and meat in it, but bro the bread is the problem. That long bun gets pressed onto a griddle slicked with oil, face down, so it drinks up the fat like a sponge. By the time it is golden and crispy it has soaked in way more oil than you think.

Then they finish it with a zigzag of mayo and chilli sauce on top, which is another 100 plus calories of pure topping. One whole roti john is a proper meal, around 650, and the loaded mutton ones the hawkers do can hit 850. That is not a snack lah, that is dinner.
lighter: Share a whole one or order a half. Half a roti john is a much more sensible 325 or so.
Skip the mayo drizzle on top and just have the chilli sauce. The mayo is pure add-on fat.
Ask them to go easy on the oil when they griddle it. Less oil in the bread is the single biggest saving.

faq.q: How many calories in a roti john?
faq.a: A whole standard roti john is around 650 calories. The bread soaks up the griddle oil, and the mayo drizzle on top adds even more. Mutton versions can hit 850.

faq.q: Is roti john a healthy breakfast?
faq.a: Not really. The egg and meat give you protein, but the long bun fried in oil and topped with mayo makes it a heavy, fatty meal. Treat it as one full meal, not a light start.

faq.q: How do I make roti john lower calorie?
faq.a: Order a half instead of a whole, skip the mayo drizzle, and ask for less oil on the griddle. That can easily cut it down by 200 or more.

foods.name: Chicken Chop
foods.metaDescription: A mamak chicken chop plate is around 700 calories with fries and sauce. The chicken is lean, the fries and gravy do the damage. Breakdown inside.
foods.summary: A full plate is about 700 calories. The chicken is fine, it is the fries and gravy that climb.
foods.answer: A mamak Western chicken chop plate is around 700 calories. You get a big deboned chicken thigh or breast (deep-fried or grilled), a pile of fries, a splash of coleslaw, and a ladle of black pepper or brown gravy. That works out to roughly 38g protein, 55g carbs and 36g fat. Grilled instead of fried knocks it down noticeably.
realTalk: The chicken in a chicken chop is actually a solid protein hit, 38g, which is great. The problem is everything sharing the plate with it. The fries are 300 plus calories on their own, the gravy is thickened with butter and flour, and the coleslaw is basically cabbage swimming in mayo.

If they deep-fry the chicken with a flour batter, you are adding another layer of oil on top. Ask for grilled and you save a good 150. A grilled chicken chop plate is honestly not a bad meal at all, it is the deep-fried version drowning in gravy and fries that tips it over.
lighter: Order it grilled (panggang) instead of deep-fried. That alone saves around 150 calories.
Swap the fries for extra salad or coleslaw if they let you. The fries are the biggest single number on the plate.
Ask for the gravy on the side and dip instead of drowning. The brown sauce is butter and flour heavy.

faq.q: How many calories in a chicken chop?
faq.a: A full mamak chicken chop plate is around 700 calories with fries, coleslaw and gravy. The chicken is lean protein, but the fries and butter-based gravy push it up.

faq.q: Is grilled chicken chop healthier than fried?
faq.a: Yes, clearly. Grilling skips the flour batter and the deep-fry oil, which saves you around 150 calories. Order it panggang if you want the lighter version.

faq.q: Is chicken chop good for losing weight?
faq.a: The chicken itself is great, 38g of protein. Order it grilled, go easy on the fries and keep the gravy on the side, and it becomes a genuinely solid high-protein meal.

foods.name: Lamb Chop
foods.metaDescription: A mamak lamb chop plate is around 680 calories with fries and black pepper sauce. Lamb is fattier than chicken. Full breakdown inside.
foods.summary: A full plate is about 680 calories. Lamb is fattier than chicken, so the meat itself counts more.
foods.answer: A mamak Western lamb chop plate is around 680 calories. You get two to three lamb chops (grilled, usually two ribs of meat), a pile of fries, a bit of coleslaw, and black pepper or mushroom sauce. That comes to roughly 40g protein, 45g carbs and 38g fat. Lamb is naturally fattier than chicken, so the meat carries more of the calories here.
realTalk: Unlike the chicken chop where the meat is lean, lamb brings its own fat to the party. There is marbling running through the chops and a strip of fat along the bone, so even grilled, the meat itself is a chunky 350 plus calories before you touch the sides.

Then you add fries and a ladle of black pepper sauce, which is usually butter and flour based, and you are at 680. It is a good protein meal at 40g, but it is not a light one. If you want it leaner, trim the fat strip off the chops and put the sauce on the side.
lighter: Trim the visible fat strip off each chop before eating. Lamb fat is dense, this saves real calories.
Swap fries for a side salad or extra veg. The fries are the easiest 200 plus to drop.
Get the black pepper or mushroom sauce on the side and dip. Those sauces are butter heavy.

faq.q: How many calories in a lamb chop plate?
faq.a: A full mamak lamb chop plate is around 680 calories with fries and sauce. Lamb is fattier than chicken, so the meat itself carries more of the calories, about 380.

faq.q: Is lamb chop higher in calories than chicken chop?
faq.a: The meat is, yes. Lamb has natural marbling and a fat strip on the bone, so it is denser than lean chicken thigh. The full plates end up close once you add the same fries and sauce.

faq.q: How do I eat lamb chop with fewer calories?
faq.a: Trim the fat strip off each chop, swap the fries for salad, and keep the sauce on the side. That can bring it down towards 500.

foods.name: Fish and Chips
foods.metaDescription: A plate of fish and chips is around 800 calories. The fish is lean, but the batter and fries are deep-fried twice over. Full breakdown.
foods.summary: A full plate is about 800 calories. The fish is innocent, the batter and fries are the problem.
foods.answer: A plate of fish and chips runs around 800 calories. The fish fillet underneath is lean white fish, maybe 150 calories of actual fish. The rest is the thick deep-fried batter coating it, the big pile of fries, and the tartar sauce on the side. That adds up to roughly 35g protein, 70g carbs and 42g fat.
realTalk: Here is the cruel joke with fish and chips. The fish itself is one of the leanest, highest-protein things you can eat. Then they wrap it in a thick beer batter and drop the whole thing in the deep fryer, so that innocent fillet comes out wearing a heavy oil-soaked jacket.

Then it sits next to a mountain of fries (also deep-fried) and a dollop of tartar, which is basically mayo. So the one healthy ingredient on the plate ends up buried in two layers of deep-fry. A takeaway portion can hit 850 plus easy. Tasty as hell, but no, it is not the light seafood option lah.
lighter: Peel some of the thick batter off the fish before eating. The batter holds most of the soaked-in oil.
Swap the fries for mushy peas or a side salad. The fries are 300 plus on their own.
Use the tartar sauce sparingly or ask for lemon instead. Tartar is mostly mayo.

faq.q: How many calories in fish and chips?
faq.a: A standard plate is around 800 calories. The fish itself is only about 160, the rest is the deep-fried batter, the fries and the tartar sauce. Large takeaway portions can hit 1000.

faq.q: Is fish and chips healthy?
faq.a: The fish is lean and high in protein, but the batter and fries are both deep-fried, so the plate as a whole is heavy in fat and carbs. It is a treat meal, not a light seafood option.

faq.q: How do I make fish and chips lighter?
faq.a: Peel off some of the batter, swap fries for mushy peas or salad, and go easy on the tartar. That can bring it down towards 450 to 500.

foods.name: Burger Bakar
foods.metaDescription: A loaded burger bakar is around 720 calories. Grilled patty, cheese, egg, special sauce, all stacked tall. Full breakdown inside.
foods.summary: One loaded burger bakar is about 720 calories. Grilled patty, but the cheese, egg and sauce stack up.
foods.answer: A loaded burger bakar (the tall grilled-burger-stall style) is around 720 calories. You get a fat flame-grilled beef patty, a slice or two of cheese, often an egg, plenty of special sauce and a soft toasted bun. That works out to roughly 35g protein, 48g carbs and 42g fat. The grilling helps a bit, but the loaded toppings pile it back on.
realTalk: Burger bakar sounds healthier than Ramly because bakar means grilled, and the patty is genuinely flame-grilled instead of swimming in margarine. But these stalls stack them tall on purpose. You get a thick patty, double cheese, an egg, sometimes beef bacon, all glued together with a heavy special sauce.

So you start with a decent grilled patty and then bury it. A basic single is around 500, but the loaded special with cheese and egg easily hits 720, and the monster double-patty ones the popular stalls sell can clear 900. The grill saves you some oil, the toppings give it all back lah.
lighter: Order the basic single patty, no egg, single cheese. The grilled patty on its own is the reasonable part.
Skip or halve the special sauce. It is mayo-based and they are not shy with it.
Drop the egg add-on. It is an easy 90 calories you will not miss on an already loaded burger.

faq.q: How many calories in a burger bakar?
faq.a: A loaded burger bakar is around 720 calories. The grilled patty is reasonable, but the cheese, egg and special sauce stack it up. A basic single is closer to 500.

faq.q: Is burger bakar healthier than a Ramly burger?
faq.a: The patty is, since it is flame-grilled instead of fried in margarine. But burger bakar stalls load on more cheese, egg and sauce, so the loaded ones end up just as heavy or heavier.

faq.q: How do I order a lighter burger bakar?
faq.a: Get the basic single patty, single cheese, no egg, and go easy on the special sauce. That keeps it around 500 instead of 720 or more.

variants.name: Basic single
variants.note: One patty, one cheese, no egg

foods.name: Begedil (Bergedil)
foods.metaDescription: How many calories in begedil? About 190 kcal for 2 pieces. Mashed potato, fried, sneaky oil. Real numbers and lighter ways to eat it.
foods.summary: 2 fried potato patties run about 190 kcal. Tasty but oily, easy to eat five.
foods.answer: Two pieces of begedil come in around 190 calories, so roughly 95 each. It is mashed potato with a bit of minced meat, shaped into a patty and deep fried, so most of the damage is potato plus the oil it soaks up. One or two next to your nasi is fine, just do not treat them like free side dishes.
realTalk: Begedil feels harmless because it is small and it is just potato, right? But it is fried, and fried potato drinks oil like nobody business. Each little patty is around 95 calories before you even dip it in chilli.

The problem at a kenduri is you take five without thinking, that is nearly 500 calories of side dish on top of your rice and curry. If you love begedil, take two, enjoy them properly, and move on lah.
lighter: Air fry or oven bake instead of deep fry, you save a big chunk of the oil calories
Stick to 2 pieces and let your rice portion be the filler, not the begedil
Pat them on tissue first so the surface oil drains off before you eat

faq.q: How many calories in one begedil?
faq.a: About 95 calories per piece, depending on size and how much meat is inside.

faq.q: Is begedil bad for weight loss?
faq.a: Not bad in small amounts. It is fried potato so it is calorie dense, but 1 to 2 pieces fits fine in a deficit. The trap is eating five without noticing.

faq.q: Is air fried begedil healthier?
faq.a: Yes, you cut a good amount of the absorbed oil, so an air fried piece can be closer to 70 calories instead of 95.

foods.name: Cekodok Pisang (Jemput-Jemput)
foods.metaDescription: Calories in cekodok pisang? Around 225 kcal for 3 pieces. Fried banana balls with flour and sugar. Real numbers and lighter swaps inside.
foods.summary: 3 banana fritter balls land near 225 kcal. Sweet, fried, and you never stop at three.
foods.answer: Three pieces of cekodok pisang sit around 225 calories, so roughly 75 each. It is overripe banana mashed with flour and sugar, then deep fried into balls. The banana is fine, it is the flour, sugar, and frying oil stacking up that makes it add fast. Great with teh, just count how many you actually eat.
realTalk: Cekodok pisang is dangerous because it is tea time food, you eat it standing up not even sitting down. Each ball is small, maybe 75 calories, so your brain says no harm. Then you look down and the plate is empty and you ate six.
Six pieces is 450 calories of basically fried sweet dough, and you did not even feel full. If you want the banana fix, eat three with your teh and stop, or just eat an actual banana for 100 calories.
lighter: Make them smaller so 3 pieces is genuinely 3 small balls, not 3 fistfuls
