foods.name: Nasi Pecel
foods.serving: 1 plate (rice, blanched vegetables, peanut sauce, 2 peyek)
foods.metaDescription: Nasi pecel is about 550 calories a plate. The vegetables are nearly free; the peanut sauce and the peyek crackers are where the calories are.
foods.summary: Nasi pecel is rice with blanched spinach, bean sprouts, long beans and papaya leaves, drowned in spicy peanut sauce and served with crunchy peyek. Madiun and Blitar claim it.
foods.answer: A plate of nasi pecel with two peyek is about 550 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists a full bowl at 553 calories. The vegetables are only about 40 calories; the rice is 235, the peanut sauce is 170 and the two peyek add about 105.
realTalk: This is the dish that looks like a salad and eats like a dessert. A pile of blanched kangkung, tauge, kacang panjang and daun pepaya, 120g of it, is about 40 calories. Then the stall pours 50g of sambal pecel on top and that is 170 calories, because peanut sauce is peanuts, palm sugar and oil. The sauce is more than four times the vegetables.

Peyek is the other thing. It is a thin rice-flour cracker fried with peanuts or tiny anchovies, and one piece around 12g is about 50 calories. Two come with the plate, but they are 500 rupiah each and people take five. Five peyek is 250 calories of cracker, more than the rice.

The rice itself is the normal 180g scoop at a pecel stall, about 235 calories. Some places serve it on a pincuk (folded banana leaf) which naturally holds less, and that is the version you want. Full plate service tends to be 250g of rice.

Protein is low at 16g for 550 calories, and that is a problem for staying full. The common fix at the warung is adding telur ceplok (fried egg, about 110 calories) or tempe goreng, and that is a better use of the extra calories than more peyek.
lighter: Ask for extra sayur and less rice. The vegetables are 40 calories for a big handful, so doubling them costs nothing.
Sambal pecel on the side, and use half. Halving the sauce saves 85 calories and there is still plenty of flavour.
Two peyek maximum. Each one is 50 calories and they are the easiest thing to overeat on the table.
Add a boiled or fried egg instead of tempe mendoan. Egg gives 6g protein for 70 to 110 calories.
Pick the pincuk version. The banana leaf cone holds less rice, closer to 150g.

portions.label: Large with telur ceplok and 4 peyek

faq.q: How many calories in nasi pecel?
faq.a: About 550 calories for a plate with rice, vegetables, peanut sauce and two peyek. Without rice the pecel alone is around 210.

faq.q: Is nasi pecel healthy?
faq.a: The vegetable part is very good, but the plate is 76g of carbs and only 16g protein. Adding an egg and cutting the peyek makes it a solid meal.

faq.q: How many calories in sambal pecel?
faq.a: About 170 calories per 50g ladle, which is roughly 3.4 calories per gram. It is peanuts, palm sugar and oil, so it adds up quickly.

faq.q: How many calories in one peyek?
faq.a: About 50 calories for a standard 12g peyek kacang. The bigger peyek teri from Madiun can be 70 to 80 each.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (nasi pecel 1 bowl 553 kcal), components estimated

foods.name: Nasi Campur Bali
foods.serving: 1 plate (rice, shredded chicken, 2 sate lilit, lawar, sambal matah, fried peanuts)
foods.metaDescription: A plate of nasi campur Bali runs about 700 calories. Shredded chicken and sate lilit are the good part; the fried peanuts and coconut lawar add up fast.
foods.summary: Nasi campur Bali is a plate of white rice ringed with small portions: shredded spiced chicken, sate lilit, lawar, sambal matah, fried peanuts and often a piece of crispy chicken skin or a boiled egg.
foods.answer: A typical warung nasi campur Bali is about 700 calories. That is 200g of rice at 260 calories, 60g of shredded chicken at 120, two sate lilit at 100, a spoon of lawar at 80 and about 140 calories of sambal matah and fried peanuts.
realTalk: There is no single nasi campur Bali, so the calorie count depends on how many little piles you get. The Rp 15,000 warung version has rice, ayam sisit, a spoon of lawar and sambal, about 550 calories. The Rp 35,000 tourist plate in Ubud adds sate lilit, crispy chicken skin, a boiled egg, tempe and peanuts and lands closer to 900.

The parts that look small but hit hard: fried peanuts at 90 calories for a 15g spoon, chicken skin at 80 for one crispy piece, and lawar at 80 per 50g because it is grated coconut mixed with the vegetables. Sambal matah is raw shallots, lemongrass and chili but it is dressed in oil, so a spoon is about 50 calories.

The good news is the protein. Between shredded chicken, two sate lilit and the egg you are at 30g on a standard plate, which is better than most Indonesian rice plates. Sate lilit is minced fish with coconut, about 51 calories a skewer, so two of them cost less than one spoon of peanuts.

Ayam betutu versions are richer than ayam sisit versions. Betutu is chicken slow cooked in a heavy spice paste with oil, and a betutu-based plate runs about 100 calories higher than the shredded chicken one.
lighter: Less rice, more ayam sisit. The chicken is spiced and shredded, not fried, so extra chicken is cheap in calories.
Skip the fried peanuts. One spoon is 90 calories and it is the least interesting thing on the plate.
Ask for lawar without extra coconut, or take the sayur urap version which uses less.
Take sambal matah over sambal goreng. Matah is raw with a little oil; the fried sambals are mostly oil.
Leave the chicken skin. One crispy piece is around 80 calories and it is gone in one bite.

faq.q: How many calories in nasi campur Bali?
faq.a: About 700 calories for a standard plate with rice, shredded chicken, two sate lilit, lawar, sambal matah and peanuts. Basic versions start around 550.

faq.q: Is nasi campur Bali healthy?
faq.a: It is one of the better rice plates because the chicken is shredded rather than fried and you get about 30g protein. The fried peanuts, chicken skin and coconut lawar are what push it up.

faq.q: How many calories in sambal matah?
faq.a: About 50 calories per tablespoon. The shallots and lemongrass are nothing, but it is dressed with coconut or vegetable oil.

faq.q: How many calories in nasi campur babi guling?
faq.a: Around 950 calories. Roast pork with crackling is far fattier than shredded chicken, and the crackling alone is about 150 calories per piece.

foods.name: Lontong Sayur
foods.serving: 1 bowl (lontong, coconut vegetable gravy, telur balado, kerupuk)
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of lontong sayur with egg and kerupuk is about 450 calories. The coconut gravy is the sneaky part, not the compressed rice.
foods.summary: Lontong sayur is compressed rice cake sliced into a bowl of coconut milk vegetable gravy, usually chayote or young jackfruit, topped with a boiled egg, kerupuk and fried shallots.
foods.answer: A standard bowl of lontong sayur with an egg and kerupuk is about 450 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists the lontong and gravy alone at 357 calories for a 400g bowl. Add a telur balado at 71 and a kerupuk at 50 and you are at 450.
realTalk: Lontong is lighter than rice, and most people do not know this. Because it is compressed and cooked with a lot of water, lontong is about 105 calories per 100g against 130 for cooked rice. A bowl with 200g of lontong is about 210 calories of rice, where a plate of nasi is 260 to 325.

The gravy is where the coconut milk lives. Sayur labu siam in santan is around 120 calories for a 150ml ladle, and it looks like soup so nobody counts it. The Padang version with gulai nangka and extra chili oil on top is thicker and closer to 180 per ladle.

The default breakfast at a Betawi stall is Rp 10,000 to 15,000 and includes one egg and one kerupuk, which is 450 calories with 15g protein. That is honestly one of the cheaper and lighter breakfasts on the street, as long as you do not add the semur tahu, the tempe orek and the second kerupuk.

The real trap is the lontong cap go meh and the lontong sayur with ayam opor and sambal goreng ati. Those are festival versions at 750 calories or more, and eating them like a daily breakfast is how people gain during Lebaran week.
lighter: Ask for the gravy 'jangan terlalu banyak kuah'. Less coconut gravy is 40 to 60 calories saved per bowl.
Keep the egg, lose the kerupuk. The egg is your protein; the kerupuk is 50 calories of fried starch.
Choose the labu siam gravy over the nangka gulai if there is a choice. It tends to be thinner and less oily.
Skip the extra sambal goreng on top. That red oil layer is pure fat, about 45 calories per teaspoon.
Do not add lontong. Half a lontong extra is another 100 calories.

portions.label: Standard bowl with egg and kerupuk
With opor ayam and sambal goreng ati

faq.q: How many calories in lontong sayur?
faq.a: About 450 calories for a bowl with lontong, coconut gravy, one egg and a kerupuk. Without the egg and kerupuk it is about 357.

faq.q: Is lontong lower in calories than rice?
faq.a: Yes, per 100g lontong is about 105 calories versus 130 for cooked rice, because it holds more water. A bowl with 200g lontong is about 210 calories.

faq.q: How many calories in lontong sayur Padang?
faq.a: Around 520 calories because the gulai nangka is thicker and comes with a spoon of chili oil on top.

faq.q: Is lontong sayur good for weight loss?
faq.a: It is a reasonable breakfast at 450 calories with 15g protein. Keep the egg, skip the kerupuk and ask for less gravy and it drops under 400.

foods.name: Nasi Liwet
foods.serving: 1 plate (coconut rice, labu siam, shredded opor chicken, areh, pindang egg)
foods.metaDescription: A plate of nasi liwet Solo is about 580 calories. The thick areh coconut cream on top is the part nobody counts.
foods.summary: Nasi liwet Solo is rice cooked in coconut milk and stock, served on a banana leaf pincuk with chayote in thin gravy, shredded opor chicken, a pindang egg and a spoon of thick coconut cream called areh.
foods.answer: A standard pincuk of nasi liwet Solo is about 580 calories. The coconut rice is 275 calories for 200g, the labu siam gravy 70, shredded opor chicken 100, areh 65 and a pindang egg 70. FatSecret lists the rice alone at 221 per 160g bowl.
realTalk: The rice is cooked in santan and chicken stock, which brings it to about 138 calories per 100g on FatSecret. That is only a little more than plain rice, because Solo-style liwet uses thin coconut milk. A 200g scoop is 275 calories. The Sundanese version cooked in a kastrol pot with more oil, ikan asin and petai is heavier, roughly 320 for the same scoop.

Areh is the giveaway. That white blob on top is coconut milk reduced until it is almost solid, and a 30g spoon is 65 calories, nearly all fat. Stalls near Keprabon serve it generously. The opor chicken shreds are cooked in the same coconut base so 50g of chicken carries another 100 calories, roughly half of that from the gravy.

The labu siam in thin santan is the light part, about 70 calories per ladle, and the pindang egg is 70. So a plate with a good amount of egg and labu and less areh is a fairly balanced 500 calorie meal with 22g protein. It is sold at Rp 15,000 to 25,000 in Solo, more at the famous places.

Where it goes wrong is the add-ons: telur pindang is fine, but sambal goreng ati (liver in coconut chili), tahu bacem and a whole piece of ayam opor each add 100 to 200. The full plate at a wedding is 900 calories.
lighter: Ask for less areh, or none. That single spoon is 65 calories of pure coconut fat.
Double the labu siam. The chayote gravy is 70 calories a ladle and fills you up.
Take the pindang egg and shredded chicken; skip the ayam opor piece which comes with far more gravy.
The pincuk (banana leaf cone) holds less rice than a plate. Choose it.
Skip tahu bacem and tempe bacem. They are braised in palm sugar and then fried, about 90 calories a piece.

faq.q: How many calories in nasi liwet?
faq.a: About 580 calories for a standard Solo plate with labu siam, shredded chicken, areh and a pindang egg. The rice alone is about 275 calories per 200g.

faq.q: Is nasi liwet high in fat?
faq.a: The rice is moderate at about 5g fat per 200g. The 22g fat on the plate comes mostly from the areh and the opor gravy on the chicken.

faq.q: What is the difference between nasi liwet Solo and Sunda in calories?
faq.a: The Sunda version is cooked in a pot with more oil and served with fried ikan asin, tempe and sambal, so it is about 700 calories versus 580 for the Solo plate.

faq.q: How many calories in areh?
faq.a: About 65 calories per tablespoon. It is coconut milk boiled down until thick, so it is close to 90% fat by calories.

foods.name: Gudeg
foods.serving: 1 plate nasi gudeg (rice, gudeg, krecek, pindang egg, areh)
foods.metaDescription: A plate of nasi gudeg with krecek and egg is about 650 calories. The jackfruit stew is basically sugar and coconut milk, so it eats like a dessert.
foods.summary: Gudeg is young jackfruit stewed for hours in coconut milk and palm sugar until it turns dark and sweet. In Yogyakarta it is served over rice with spicy krecek (cow skin), a pindang egg and thick areh.
foods.answer: A standard plate of nasi gudeg is about 650 calories: 200g rice at 260, 100g gudeg at 130, krecek at 110, a pindang egg at 70 and a spoon of areh at 80. FatSecret Indonesia lists the gudeg stew itself at 127 calories per 100g.
realTalk: Gudeg is sweet for a reason. The jackfruit is stewed in coconut milk and gula jawa for six to eight hours, and by the end a 100g scoop is 127 calories with 22g of carbs, mostly sugar, and 5g of fat. It has almost no protein, under 2g per 100g. So the brown pile that looks like a vegetable dish is closer to a sweet stew.

Krecek is the red stuff on the side, and it is cow skin crackers rehydrated in coconut chili sauce. 50g is about 110 calories, mostly fat from the santan and the chili oil floating on top. Then areh, the thick white coconut cream, is 80 calories for a 40g spoon. Between gudeg, krecek and areh you have 320 calories before rice.

The dry Yogya style (gudeg kering) is more concentrated than the wet Solo style (gudeg basah). Kering has been cooked down longer so the same 100g scoop has more sugar and coconut, about 150 calories, while the wet version is closer to 110. If you are choosing, wet is lighter.
A Rp 15,000 to 25,000 plate at Wijilan or Mbarek gets you 650 calories with 95g of carbs and only 20g protein. Add ayam kampung opor and you are near 900, and that is the usual tourist order.
lighter: Ask for less rice and no areh. Between them that is 200 calories saved without touching the gudeg.
Take the telur pindang and skip the ayam opor. The egg is 70 calories with 6g protein; a piece of opor chicken in gravy is 250 or more.
Ask for gudeg basah (wet) if the stall does both. It has less sugar per scoop.
Krecek is the fattiest part of the plate. A small spoon, not a ladle.
Pair it with tahu or tempe bacem only if you skip the egg. Do not stack all three.

faq.q: How many calories in nasi gudeg?
faq.a: About 650 calories for a plate with rice, gudeg, krecek, a pindang egg and areh. The gudeg stew itself is about 127 calories per 100g.

faq.q: Is gudeg healthy?
faq.a: Not really. It is sweet stewed jackfruit with coconut milk, under 2g protein per 100g and mostly sugar. It is fine as an occasional meal but it is closer to dessert than vegetables.

faq.q: Does gudeg have a lot of sugar?
faq.a: Yes. Roughly 22g of carbs per 100g, and most of that is palm sugar absorbed during the long stewing. The dry Yogya style has more than the wet Solo style.

faq.q: How many calories in gudeg with krecek?
faq.a: About 240 calories for 100g gudeg plus 50g krecek, no rice. The krecek carries most of the fat.

foods.name: Mie Ayam
foods.serving: 1 bowl (noodles, chicken in kecap, sawi, side broth)
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of mie ayam is about 450 calories. The chicken looks small because the oil in the bowl is doing most of the work.
foods.summary: Mie ayam is the Indonesian street noodle: yellow noodles tossed in seasoned oil and soy, topped with diced chicken cooked in kecap manis, blanched sawi and a small bowl of broth on the side.
foods.answer: A normal cart bowl of mie ayam is about 450 calories. FatSecret Indonesia puts a 240g bowl at 421 calories; the warung version with more oil in the bottom of the bowl lands closer to 450. Add two bakso and it is about 560, add pangsit goreng and 620.
realTalk: Look at the bottom of the bowl before you mix. That pool of oil, chicken fat and kecap is where 100 of the 450 calories live. The seller ladles it in first, then the noodles, then the chicken. It is what makes cheap mie ayam taste good and it is why a bowl with barely 50g of chicken still has 20g of fat.

The noodles are about 150g cooked, around 210 calories, which is actually less than a plate of rice. The chicken topping is 50g of thigh meat cooked down in kecap manis and more oil, about 110 calories. The sawi is 10. So a plain bowl without extras is really 450, and Rp 12,000 to 18,000 at most carts.

Then the extras. Two bakso add about 110 calories. Pangsit rebus (boiled wonton) is 30 each. Pangsit goreng is 60 to 70 each and people take three. Ceker (chicken feet) are about 50 for two. A 'mie ayam bakso pangsit komplit' is 650 to 700 calories and still only about 30g protein.
The broth on the side is nearly free at 20 calories, unless the seller has floated chicken oil on it. Drink it if it is clear, skip it if it has a yellow film.
lighter: Ask for 'minyaknya sedikit' (less oil). Some sellers will, and it drops the bowl by 60 to 80 calories.
Add bakso instead of pangsit goreng. Two bakso is 110 calories with real protein; three fried wontons is 200 calories of fried skin.
Ask for extra sawi. It is free at most carts and it is the only vegetable in the bowl.
Skip the sambal if it is the oily kind. Rawit in vinegar is fine; sambal in oil is another 40 calories.
Mie ayam without the kecap manis drizzle on top saves about 30 calories of sugar.

variants.note: Mushroom cooked in the same kecap oil

variants.name: Mie ayam bakso pangsit goreng
variants.note: Two bakso and three fried wontons

faq.q: How many calories in mie ayam?
faq.a: About 450 calories for a standard cart bowl. FatSecret lists 421 for a 240g bowl. With bakso it is about 560.

faq.q: How many calories in mie ayam bakso?
faq.a: About 560 calories. Each bakso adds roughly 55 calories, and most stalls give two.

faq.q: Is mie ayam healthy for a diet?
faq.a: It is moderate at 450 calories, but only 18g protein and 20g fat. Ask for less oil, add bakso for protein and skip the fried wontons.

faq.q: How many calories in mie ayam pangsit?
faq.a: Around 520 with two boiled wontons, or 620 to 680 with three fried ones. The fried pangsit is the biggest add-on.

foods.name: Mie Goreng Jawa
foods.metaDescription: A plate of mie goreng Jawa from a charcoal cart is about 620 calories. The kecap manis and the egg swirled in with the oil are what push it up.
foods.summary: Mie goreng Jawa is thick yellow noodles fried over charcoal in a wok with kecap manis, egg, chicken, cabbage and tomato. Yogyakarta and Solo carts do it one plate at a time.
foods.answer: A plate of mie goreng Jawa from a bakmi Jawa cart is about 620 calories. That is 200g of noodles at 280, one egg at 70, about 15g of oil at 130, 20g of kecap manis at 55, 40g of chicken at 70 and cabbage and tomato at 20.
realTalk: The kecap manis is the thing people forget. A proper bakmi Jawa cart pours it in twice, once when the egg goes in and again at the end, and 20g is 55 calories of pure sugar. The dish is sweet for a reason. The oil is the other invisible number: 15g for one plate is normal, and that is 130 calories before anything else.

The noodles are the bulk at 200g cooked, about 280 calories, more than a mie ayam bowl because Jawa-style uses the thick bakmi. The egg adds 70 and a decent amount of the plate's 22g protein. The chicken is usually kampung chicken shredded thin, maybe 40g, so it is more for taste than protein.

Bakmi Jawa carts in Yogyakarta charge Rp 18,000 to 30,000 and cook on charcoal, one wok per order, which sounds artisanal but does not change the calories. The godhog (soup) version is the same ingredients in broth and lands around 500 because there is less oil and less kecap. The nyemek version (half wet) sits in between at 560.
The emping or kerupuk on the side is another 50 calories, and the free acar (pickled cucumber and chili) is the only thing on the table that is close to zero.
lighter: Order the godhog (soup) version. Same noodles and egg, about 120 calories less because the wok oil and second kecap pour are gone.
Ask for 'kecapnya sedikit'. Half the kecap is 30 calories of sugar gone and the dish is still sweet.
Ask for extra kol and sawi. Vegetables are the cheapest way to make the plate bigger.
Skip the emping. 50 calories of cracker you will not remember eating.
If there is a choice of egg count, one is enough. The second egg is often fried separately in more oil.

portions.label: Large with extra egg and emping

variants.name: Magelangan (noodles mixed with rice)
variants.note: Half rice, half noodles, same oil

faq.q: How many calories in mie goreng Jawa?
faq.a: About 620 calories for a standard cart plate with egg and chicken. The soup version (godhog) is around 500.

faq.q: Is bakmi Jawa healthy?
faq.a: It is a full meal at 620 calories with 22g protein, but 24g fat and around 20g of sugar from the kecap manis. Ask for less kecap and pick the soup version to make it lighter.

faq.q: How many calories in bakmi godhog?
faq.a: Around 500 calories. Same noodles and egg in a broth, with much less oil than the fried version.

faq.q: How much sugar is in mie goreng Jawa?
faq.a: Roughly 15 to 20g, mostly from the two pours of kecap manis. That is about the same as a can of soft drink.

foods.source: estimate from components

foods.name: Indomie Goreng
foods.metaDescription: One pack of Indomie goreng is 380 calories on the label. Add the fried egg everyone adds and it is about 455.
foods.summary: Indomie Mi Goreng is Indonesia's instant fried noodle, 85g of noodles with a seasoning oil, kecap manis, chili sauce and fried shallot sachet. Most people cook it with an egg.
foods.answer: One pack of Indomie goreng with a fried egg is about 455 calories. The packaging lists 380 calories per 85g pack (14g fat, 54g carbs, 8g protein), and a fried egg adds about 75. At a warkop with double noodles it is 835.
realTalk: The label is honest, and the number is 380 per pack. Most of that is the noodle block itself, about 300 calories, because instant noodles are flash fried in palm oil before they are dried. The seasoning sachets add about 80 more: the oil sachet is about 45 calories, the kecap manis 25, the chili and shallot the rest.

The problem is nobody eats one dry pack. The standard warkop order is 'Indomie goreng telur' at Rp 10,000 to 15,000, and the egg is fried in more oil, so that is 75 to 100 calories on top. Add a slice of cheese (about 60) or a kornet spoon (about 70) and you are at 600. Indomie goreng double with telur and kornet is 900 calories, and it is 11pm.

Protein is the weak point. One pack is 8g, the egg brings it to 14g. For 455 calories that is low, which is why you are hungry again in two hours. Two packs is not the fix, that is 760 calories for 16g protein. Two eggs on one pack is 530 calories for 20g protein and holds much better.

If you add the full oil sachet plus your own oil for the egg, the pack is about 19g fat, which is around 40% of the calories. Draining the noodles properly and skipping half the oil sachet takes about 25 calories off. Small, but free.
lighter: One pack, two eggs, not two packs, one egg. Same 500ish calories with 20g protein instead of 16g.
Use half the oil sachet. The kecap and chili carry the flavour; the oil sachet is 45 calories of palm oil.
Throw in a handful of sawi or cabbage while the noodles boil. Adds volume for about 10 calories.
Skip the cheese and kornet at the warkop. Each one is 60 to 70 calories with little to show for it.
Do not drink the boiling water. Obvious, but the rebus version's soup is where the sodium and half the seasoning oil ends up.

portions.label: 1 pack, no egg, half oil sachet
Double (2 packs) with egg and kornet

variants.name: Double with egg and kornet
variants.note: Two packs, one egg, one spoon corned beef

faq.q: How many calories in one pack of Indomie goreng?
faq.a: 380 calories per 85g pack according to the packaging, with 14g fat, 54g carbs and 8g protein. With a fried egg it is about 455.

faq.q: How many calories in Indomie goreng telur?
faq.a: About 455 calories. The pack is 380 and a fried egg is roughly 75, a bit more if the warkop fries it in a lot of oil.

faq.q: Is Indomie goreng bad for weight loss?
faq.a: One pack with two eggs is about 530 calories and 20g protein, which fits a normal day. Two packs at once is 760 calories with barely any protein, and that is the version that causes problems.

faq.q: How many calories in Indomie goreng double?
faq.a: Two packs is 760 calories before the egg. With egg and kornet, about 900.

foods.source: Indomie Mi Goreng packaging label (380 kcal per 85g pack) plus 1 fried egg

foods.name: Mie Aceh
foods.serving: 1 plate (mie Aceh goreng with beef, emping)
foods.metaDescription: A plate of mie Aceh goreng with beef is about 600 calories. The thick noodles soak up a heavy curry spice paste cooked in oil.
foods.summary: Mie Aceh is thick yellow noodles cooked in a curry-like paste of chili, cardamom, cumin and turmeric with beef, goat, shrimp or crab. It comes goreng (dry), tumis (moist) or kuah (soup), with emping and pickled shallots.
foods.answer: A restaurant plate of mie Aceh goreng with beef is about 600 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists a lighter 205g version at 238 calories, but a real Rp 25,000 plate has around 200g of noodles, 60g of beef, 15g of oil and emping, which lands at 600.
realTalk: Mie Aceh noodles are the thick, chewy kind, and a plate holds about 200g cooked, roughly 260 calories. Then the spice paste. It is fried in oil until the red separates, and a plate carries about 15g of oil, 130 calories, more than any other noodle dish on this site except the mamak ones. The 238 calorie figure on FatSecret is for a very small, wet portion and not what a warung gives you.

The protein depends on what you order. Daging (beef) is the standard, about 60g for 130 calories and 15g protein. Kambing (goat) is similar. Udang (shrimp) is leaner at about 80 calories for the same weight. Kepiting (crab) is the leanest meat but the plate costs Rp 45,000 to 60,000 and the crab is often fried first.

The three styles matter. Goreng (dry) is the heaviest at 600 because all the oil stays in the noodles. Tumis (moist) has some broth and is about 540. Kuah (soup) is about 480 because part of the oil floats on the soup and stays in the bowl. Same price, 120 calories difference.
Emping on the side is 50 calories for a small pile, and the acar bawang (pickled shallots) is free. Mie Aceh comes with a lot of chili already, so the extra sambal is not needed.
lighter: Order kuah (soup) instead of goreng. About 120 calories less, and the flavour is the same paste.
Pick udang or kepiting over daging. Shrimp saves about 50 calories against beef for the same portion.
Ask for 'jangan terlalu berminyak'. Some warungs will drain the paste more before tossing.
Leave the emping. 50 calories of cracker on a plate that already has 70g of carbs.
Share a plate with extra beef instead of two plates. Mie Aceh portions are generous.

components.name: Spice paste, tomato, bean sprouts, cabbage

portions.label: Large with extra beef and emping

faq.q: How many calories in mie Aceh?
faq.a: About 600 calories for a plate of mie Aceh goreng with beef. The soup (kuah) version is around 480.

faq.q: Is mie Aceh spicy enough to burn calories?
faq.a: No. Chili raises metabolism by a trivial amount. The plate is 600 calories whether you sweat or not.

faq.q: Which mie Aceh has the fewest calories?
faq.a: Mie Aceh kuah with shrimp, around 440 calories. Goreng with beef or crab is the heaviest at 600 to 650.

faq.q: How much fat is in mie Aceh goreng?
faq.a: About 26g per plate. The spice paste is fried in a lot of oil and the thick noodles hold on to all of it.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (mie Aceh 116 kcal/100g) scaled to a warung portion with beef and oil, components estimated

foods.name: Soto Ayam
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of soto ayam is about 310 calories without rice. With a plate of rice and a sprinkle of koya it is closer to 600.
foods.summary: Soto ayam is turmeric chicken soup with shredded chicken, glass noodles, cabbage, a boiled egg and fried shallots. The Lamongan version adds koya, a powder of fried garlic and prawn crackers.
foods.answer: A bowl of soto ayam is about 310 calories on its own. FatSecret Indonesia lists a 241g bowl at 312 calories with 24g protein. The rice most people order with it adds another 260, and a heavy spoon of koya adds 60.
realTalk: Soto ayam is one of the better street meals in Indonesia if you stop at the bowl. 310 calories, 24g protein, and the broth is turmeric and stock rather than coconut. The chicken is shredded, so 60g looks like a lot in the bowl, and it is 100 calories. The half boiled egg is 35. The bihun is 40g, about 45 calories, and the cabbage and tomato are close to nothing.

The number moves when you add the plate of rice, and everybody does. Nasi at 200g is 260 calories, so 'soto ayam plus nasi' is 570 before anything else. Some places put the rice in the bowl (soto campur), some serve it separate (soto pisah), same calories either way. A Rp 15,000 to 20,000 bowl becomes a 600 calorie lunch.

Koya is the Lamongan twist and it hits harder than it looks. It is fried garlic and crushed prawn crackers, about 60 calories per heaped spoon, and the taste is good enough that people take two. The oily yellow film on top of Surabaya-style soto is chicken fat and turmeric oil, maybe another 40 calories if the ladle catches it.
The side dishes on the table are the real trap. Sate usus, sate telur puyuh, perkedel and tempe goreng are all 60 to 100 calories each, and the bill only shows you the sticks afterwards.
lighter: Skip the rice or take half. Soto with 100g rice is 440 calories and the broth fills the gap.
One spoon of koya, not two. Each one is about 60 calories.
Ask for the ladle from below the oil line. The yellow film on top is fat.
Add a whole egg instead of the half. 35 extra calories for 3g more protein.
Leave the sate usus and perkedel on the table. They are small but 60 to 100 calories each.

components.name: Turmeric broth with a little oil

faq.q: How many calories in soto ayam?
faq.a: About 310 calories per bowl without rice. Add a plate of rice and it is around 570.

faq.q: Is soto ayam good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes, one of the better options. 24g protein for 310 calories, clear broth, and it is filling. Just watch the rice and the koya.

faq.q: How many calories in soto ayam with rice?
faq.a: Around 570 calories with 200g of rice, or 440 with half rice.

faq.q: How many calories in koya?
faq.a: About 60 calories per heaped tablespoon. It is fried garlic and crushed prawn crackers, so it is mostly oil and starch.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (soto ayam 1 bowl 312 kcal, 24g protein)

foods.name: Soto Betawi
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of soto Betawi is about 365 calories without rice, and two thirds of that is fat from the coconut milk and beef. With rice and emping it passes 650.
foods.summary: Soto Betawi is Jakarta's rich beef soup made with coconut milk, sometimes milk too, with chunks of beef and offal, tomato, fried potato and emping crackers.
foods.answer: A bowl of soto Betawi is about 365 calories without rice. FatSecret Indonesia lists a 270g bowl at 363 calories, with 56% of it from fat. With a plate of rice at 260 and a handful of emping at 50, the meal is about 675.
realTalk: This is the fatty soto, and the broth is the reason. Coconut milk, sometimes evaporated milk on top of that, and the fat that renders out of beef brisket and offal. A 200ml ladle of the broth alone is about 135 calories, more than the meat in the bowl. The white creamy look is not a trick of the light, it is 27g of fat per bowl.

The meat is usually a mix: 80g of daging, babat (tripe), paru (lung) or usus, about 150 calories. Daging only is the leanest choice. Paru goreng versions are heavier because the lung is fried first, adding maybe 60 calories. The fried potato and tomato are 30. The emping crackers on top or on the side are another 50 for a small pile.

It is a Rp 25,000 to 40,000 bowl in Jakarta, and it is nearly always eaten with rice, so plan on 630 to 700 calories for the meal. For that you get only about 20g protein, which is not great value. The Betawi soto is a comfort food, not a protein dish.
The trick is that the fat floats. If you eat the meat and half the broth, you are closer to 280 calories. If you drink every drop and dip the emping in it, you are at 415 before rice.
lighter: Ask for daging only, no jeroan. Tripe and lung soak up broth and lung is often fried.
Leave half the broth. Most of the fat is in the liquid, not the meat.
Half rice. 130 calories saved, and the broth is rich enough to make it feel like plenty.
Emping is 50 calories per small pile. Skip it or take three pieces.
Squeeze the lime and add sambal. Both are free and cut the fatty taste so you need less broth.

variants.name: Soto Betawi susu (with milk added)
variants.note: Evaporated milk on top of santan

faq.q: How many calories in soto Betawi?
faq.a: About 365 calories per bowl without rice. With rice it is around 625, and with emping and extra broth about 700.

faq.q: Is soto Betawi high in fat?
faq.a: Yes, about 27g fat per bowl, which is more than half the calories. The coconut milk broth and the beef fat are the reason.

faq.q: Soto Betawi or soto ayam, which has fewer calories?
faq.a: Soto ayam by a lot. Soto ayam is about 310 calories with 24g protein; soto Betawi is 365 with 16g protein and nearly double the fat.

faq.q: How many calories in soto Betawi susu?
faq.a: Around 410 calories. The evaporated or fresh milk added to the coconut broth pushes it up by about 45 calories per bowl.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (soto Betawi 1 bowl 363 kcal, 135 kcal/100g)

foods.name: Rawon
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of rawon is about 290 calories without rice. The black keluak broth is lighter than it looks; the salted egg and kerupuk on the side are not.
foods.summary: Rawon is the East Javanese beef soup coloured black with keluak nut, served with short bean sprouts, sambal, lime and often a salted egg. It is nearly always eaten with rice.
foods.answer: A bowl of rawon is about 290 calories without rice. FatSecret Indonesia lists a 241g bowl at 288 calories with 32% of the energy from protein. Add rice at 260 and a salted egg at 120 and nasi rawon komplit is about 670.
realTalk: Rawon looks heavy because it is black, but the broth is water, keluak paste and beef stock, no coconut milk. A 200ml ladle is about 90 calories, most of that from beef fat that renders into the soup. The meat is the main event: 80g of diced brisket or shank at around 165 calories and 20g protein. That is a good ratio for a street soup.

The sides are where nasi rawon gets big. The plate of rice is 260. The telur asin (salted duck egg) that comes standard in Surabaya is about 120 calories, and it is fatty because it is a duck egg cured in salt. A kerupuk udang is 20 to 50 depending on size. Tempe goreng on the side is 95 a piece. A full Rp 25,000 to 35,000 nasi rawon komplit at a Surabaya warung is 670 to 750 calories.

The Rawon Setan style of late-night stalls uses bigger cuts and fattier meat, and a bowl runs around 350 rather than 290. Rawon buntut (oxtail) is fattier still, closer to 400 because oxtail has a lot of fat and gelatin attached.
Short bean sprouts (tauge pendek), sambal terasi and lime are the free part, and they are what make rawon taste like rawon. Load them on.
lighter: Rawon with half rice and no salted egg is about 420 calories with 26g protein. That is a solid lunch.
Ask for daging without the fat cap (tanpa lemak). Some warungs will pick leaner pieces.
Skip the salted egg or share it. 120 calories and 9g fat for one egg.
Skip the kerupuk. It is there to soak up broth, and it soaks up calories too.
Extra tauge. It is free, crunchy and adds nothing to the count.

portions.label: Nasi rawon komplit with salted egg and tempe

variants.name: Nasi rawon with telur asin
variants.note: Rice and a salted duck egg

faq.q: How many calories in rawon?
faq.a: About 290 calories per bowl of soup and beef, without rice. Nasi rawon with rice is around 550, and with a salted egg about 670.

faq.q: Is rawon healthy?
faq.a: Pretty good for a beef dish: 23g protein, no coconut milk, and the broth is mostly stock. The fat comes from the beef cut. It is the rice, salted egg and kerupuk that turn it into a 700 calorie meal.

faq.q: How many calories in nasi rawon?
faq.a: Around 550 calories with a normal plate of rice. Add telur asin and a piece of tempe and it is 750.

faq.q: Does keluak have calories?
faq.a: Keluak nut is oily, about 500 calories per 100g, but a bowl only uses about 10g of the paste. It adds maybe 40 calories and all of the colour.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (rawon 1 bowl 288 kcal, 119 kcal/100g)

foods.name: Bakso
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of bakso with noodles is about 480 calories. Each meatball is around 55, and the sweet soy and chili sauce adds more than you think.
foods.summary: Bakso is Indonesia's beef meatball soup from the pushcart: springy meatballs in clear beef broth with yellow noodles, bihun, a piece of tofu, fried shallots and a lot of kecap and sambal.
foods.answer: A standard cart bowl of bakso is about 480 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists a medium meatball at 57 calories and five of them at around 283; the noodles, bihun, tofu and broth add roughly 200. A bakso urat or bakso jumbo bowl runs 600 or more.
realTalk: One medium bakso is about 57 calories, and 60% of that is fat, not beef. Cart bakso is beef mixed with tapioca flour and fat, which is why it is bouncy and cheap. Five meatballs is about 285 calories and 17g protein. A bowl of 'bakso 10' at Rp 15,000 is easy to find and it doubles the count.

The rest of the bowl is smaller than people assume. Mie kuning 50g is 70, bihun 30g is 35, one tahu is 40 and the clear broth is 40 if it is not too oily. So a standard bowl is 480 and the meatballs are 60% of it. This is why bakso without noodles (bakso kuah only) at 340 is a decent protein snack.

The extras change everything. Bakso urat (tendon) is bigger, about 90 calories each. Bakso telur has a whole egg inside, about 130. Bakso jumbo or bakso beranak is a 150g ball with smaller ones inside, 300 calories on its own. A bakso Malang bowl with pangsit goreng, siomay and tahu goreng is around 620.

Then the sauce. People pour in kecap manis (25 calories per tablespoon) and sambal (often chili in oil, 40 per tablespoon) until the soup goes brown. Two spoons each and that is 130 calories added to what was a clear soup.
lighter: Order bakso kuah without mie. Five meatballs, tofu and broth is about 340 calories with 22g protein.
Skip the kecap manis or use one spoon. Each tablespoon is 25 calories of sugar.
Use rawit or vinegar chili instead of sambal in oil. The oil-based sambal is 40 calories a spoon.
Bakso halus (plain) over bakso urat or bakso telur. The plain ones are the smallest and leanest.
Ask for extra sawi or tauge. Adds crunch, adds nothing to the calories.

portions.label: Bakso urat jumbo with pangsit goreng

variants.name: Bakso Malang komplit
variants.note: Adds siomay, pangsit goreng, tahu goreng

variants.name: Bakso beranak / jumbo
variants.note: One 150g ball stuffed with smaller ones

faq.q: How many calories in one bakso?
faq.a: About 57 calories for a medium cart-sized beef meatball, according to FatSecret Indonesia. Bakso urat is around 90 and bakso telur about 130.

faq.q: How many calories in a bowl of bakso?
faq.a: About 480 calories for a standard bowl with five meatballs, noodles, tofu and broth. Without noodles it is about 340.

faq.q: Is bakso good for a diet?
faq.a: Decent if you skip the noodles and the sweet soy. Five meatballs in broth is 340 calories with 22g protein. The problem is the sauces and the extras, not the meatballs.

faq.q: How many calories in bakso Malang?
faq.a: Around 620 calories for a full bowl with siomay, fried wonton, tahu goreng and meatballs. The fried items add about 140 over a normal bowl.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (bakso daging sapi 57 kcal per medium ball, 283 kcal per bowl of balls), noodles and broth estimated

foods.name: Ayam Geprek
foods.metaDescription: One piece of ayam geprek with sambal is about 395 calories. The crispy flour coating and the oil in the sambal bawang are most of it. With rice it is 655.
foods.summary: Ayam geprek is crispy flour-coated fried chicken smashed in a mortar with raw chili and garlic sambal. It started in Yogyakarta and is now on every campus street in Indonesia.
foods.answer: One piece of ayam geprek with sambal bawang is about 395 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists it at 263 calories per 100g, so a 150g piece is 394. With a plate of rice it is about 655, and the cheese version is close to 800.
realTalk: Ayam geprek is fried chicken with a thick crunchy crust, the same style as the fast food chains, and the crust is the problem. A 150g piece is about 340 calories before sambal, and 27g of that is fat. Compare that to ayam bakar at about 290 for a similar piece. The flour coating soaks up oil like a sponge, then the smashing breaks it up so it soaks up the sambal oil too.

Sambal bawang is raw chili and garlic, but it is made by pouring hot cooking oil over the paste. A 20g spoon is about 55 calories, and the geprek stall smashes the chicken in it, so you eat every drop. Level 10 pedas does not change the calories, it just changes how fast you eat the rice to cool down.

The full order is Rp 12,000 to 20,000 with rice, and that is the 655 calorie version. Ayam geprek keju adds melted processed cheese, about 60 calories per slice and most places use two, so 800 total. Geprek with telur adds 75. Geprek mozzarella is a 900 calorie plate.
For 395 calories you get 26g protein, which is fine. The issue is the fat, about 60% of the calories. Nobody is eating this for the protein; it is a comfort meal.
lighter: Ask for dada (breast) instead of paha (thigh). Same crust, about 40 calories less.
Ask for sambal without extra oil, or take sambal ijo which is fried with less.
Half rice. Ayam geprek with 100g rice is 525 instead of 655.
Skip the keju and mozzarella. That is 120 to 250 calories of processed cheese on top of fried chicken.
Peel off the thickest chunks of crust. It sounds sad but the crust is where the oil is, and the meat underneath is normal chicken.

portions.label: With rice, cheese and fried egg

faq.q: How many calories in ayam geprek?
faq.a: About 395 calories for one piece with sambal bawang, and around 655 with rice.

faq.q: How many calories in ayam geprek keju?
faq.a: Around 800 calories with rice, because each slice of processed cheese is about 60 calories and most stalls use two.

faq.q: Is ayam geprek healthy?
faq.a: It has 26g protein per piece, but 27g fat from the flour crust and sambal oil. Once or twice a week with half rice is fine; every day is a lot of fried oil.

faq.q: Ayam geprek or ayam bakar, which is lower calorie?
faq.a: Ayam bakar, at about 290 calories per piece versus 395 for geprek. The grill does not add oil; the flour crust and sambal oil do.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (ayam geprek 263 kcal/100g, 394 kcal per piece)

foods.name: Sate Padang
foods.metaDescription: A plate of sate Padang with 10 skewers, sauce and ketupat is about 500 calories.
foods.summary: Sate Padang is beef, tongue or offal skewers from West Sumatra, boiled in spices then grilled, served under a thick yellow or red sauce made from rice flour and stock, with ketupat and fried shallots.
foods.answer: A plate of sate Padang with 10 skewers, sauce and one ketupat is about 500 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists the meat at 24 calories per skewer and 161 per 100g, so 10 skewers is about 240. The thick sauce adds about 120 and the ketupat 145.
realTalk: The meat on sate Padang is actually lean. It is beef, tongue and sometimes tripe or heart, boiled in spiced stock first and then briefly grilled without the coconut or peanut marinade that Javanese sate uses. One skewer is around 24 calories and 2.7g protein. Ten skewers is 240 calories and 27g protein, which is a better ratio than almost any other street meat.

The sauce is the surprise. That thick yellow gravy (or red in the Pariaman style) is the boiling stock thickened with rice flour, so it is starch, not fat. A 100g ladle is about 120 calories. It is poured generously and it is what you mop up with the ketupat, and one ketupat is 145 calories. So the meat is less than half the plate.

At Rp 20,000 to 30,000 for ten sticks in Jakarta or Padang, it is a decent evening meal at 500 calories with 30g protein. The version with two ketupat is 645. The kerupuk kulit (fried cow skin) that some carts add on top is another 90 for one big piece, and it goes soggy in the sauce so you eat it fast.

Sate Padang Panjang (yellow, more turmeric) and Pariaman (red, more chili) are about the same in calories. The Padang Kota version uses a darker, thinner sauce with less flour and comes out about 40 calories lighter per plate.
lighter: Ask for less sauce. Half the gravy saves 60 calories and the skewers are already seasoned from the boil.
One ketupat, not two. Each is 145 calories and it is just compressed rice.
Ask for daging (beef) skewers rather than lidah (tongue), which is fattier.
Skip the kerupuk kulit. One piece is about 90 calories and it is pure fried skin.
Order 15 skewers with one ketupat instead of 10 with two. More protein, same calories.

faq.q: How many calories in sate Padang?
faq.a: About 500 calories for a plate of 10 skewers with sauce and one ketupat. The skewers alone are about 24 calories each.

faq.q: Is sate Padang healthier than sate ayam?
faq.a: The meat is leaner, since it is boiled and grilled without peanut sauce. Ten sate Padang skewers are about 240 calories versus roughly 500 for ten chicken sate with peanut sauce.

faq.q: What is the sate Padang sauce made of?
faq.a: Beef stock thickened with rice flour and spices. It is about 120 calories per 100g ladle, mostly from the starch, not fat.

faq.q: How many calories in one sate Padang skewer?
faq.a: About 24 calories and 2.7g protein per skewer of meat, before sauce.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (sate Padang 24 kcal per skewer, 161 kcal/100g), sauce and ketupat estimated

foods.name: Sate Lilit
foods.metaDescription: Five sate lilit are about 255 calories. The minced fish is lean; the grated coconut mixed into it is where the fat comes from.
foods.summary: Sate lilit is Balinese satay made from minced fish, chicken or pork mixed with grated coconut and spice paste, wrapped around a lemongrass stalk or flat bamboo stick and grilled.
foods.answer: Five sate lilit are about 255 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists one skewer at 51 calories with 3.9g protein and 3.6g fat. That fat is mostly the grated coconut, since the fish itself is lean.
realTalk: Sate lilit is minced meat, not chunks, and the mix is roughly two parts fish to one part grated coconut. That coconut is the reason a 20g skewer is 51 calories with 64% from fat. Plain grilled fish of the same weight would be about 25. So it is not a lean protein snack, it is a moderately fatty one, but 5 skewers still gives 20g protein for 255 calories, which is fine.

Portion is the question. Warungs sell it by the stick at Rp 3,000 to 5,000, and a normal side order is 5. At a nasi campur stall you get 2 on the plate, about 100 calories. At a beach restaurant the 'sate lilit set' with 10 skewers, rice and sambal matah is around 700.

Pork sate lilit (babi) is fattier than fish (ikan) or chicken (ayam), about 65 per skewer rather than 51, because pork mince already has fat before the coconut goes in. Tuna or mahi-mahi lilit is the leanest, and it is what most tourist-area warungs use.

It is grilled over coconut husk charcoal with no sauce, so what you see is what you get. There is no peanut sauce pour like Javanese sate, which is why 5 lilit at 255 beats 5 sate ayam with sauce at about 300.
lighter: Fish or chicken lilit over pork. About 15 calories less per skewer.
Five skewers is a side. Ten is a meal. Decide which one you are ordering.
Eat it with sambal matah rather than sambal goreng. Matah is about 50 calories a spoon; the fried sambal is more.
Pair with rice and lawar rather than rice and fried peanuts. Peanuts add 90 per spoon.
Skip the kerupuk that comes with the set.

components.name: Spice paste and oil brushed on grill

portions.label: 10 skewers with rice and sambal matah

faq.q: How many calories in sate lilit?
faq.a: About 51 calories per skewer, so 255 for a side of five. Ten skewers with rice is around 700.

faq.q: Is sate lilit healthy?
faq.a: It is grilled, not fried, and five skewers give 20g protein. The grated coconut makes it about 64% fat by calories, so it is not lean, but it is a better choice than most fried sides.

faq.q: What is sate lilit made of?
faq.a: Minced fish (sometimes chicken or pork) mixed with grated coconut, Balinese spice paste, lime leaf and chili, wrapped on lemongrass and grilled.

faq.q: How many calories in sate lilit with rice?
faq.a: About 515 calories for five skewers with a normal 200g plate of rice.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (sate lilit 51 kcal per skewer, 257 kcal/100g)

foods.name: Pecel Lele
foods.serving: 1 whole fried catfish with sambal and lalapan (no rice)
foods.metaDescription: One fried catfish with sambal and raw vegetables is about 330 calories. With rice it is 590.
foods.summary: Pecel lele is whole catfish deep fried until crisp, smashed with sambal terasi and served with lalapan (raw cabbage, cucumber, basil) at tents with the famous Lamongan banner, usually with rice.
foods.answer: One whole fried catfish with sambal and lalapan is about 330 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists pecel lele at 292 calories per 150g serving, with 53% of the energy from fat. Add a plate of rice and the standard Rp 15,000 to 20,000 meal is about 590 calories.
realTalk: Catfish itself is a lean fish, around 100 calories per 100g raw. Deep frying a whole 200g fish until the tail goes crispy roughly doubles that, because the skin and the fins become oil sponges. FatSecret's 150g cooked portion at 292 calories works out to 194 per 100g, and that is a fair number for a Lamongan tent fish. So half the calories on the fish are oil.

The good news is the protein: about 24g per fish. The lalapan is basically free at 10 calories, and sambal terasi is around 30 for a spoon, mostly from the terasi and a little oil. If you eat fish, sambal and lalapan without rice it is a genuinely reasonable 330 calorie dinner. The tents also sell tempe and tahu, about 95 and 70 a piece, and those add up fast if you order the 'komplit'.

Rice is 260 for the normal plate, which puts the standard pecel lele meal at 590. Ask for nasi tambah (rice refill) and it is 850. Add es teh manis at 90 and you are at 940 for a tent dinner that felt light.
The lele are usually small farmed fish, 150 to 250g each. Some tents sell 'lele jumbo' at 350g, which is about 550 calories on its own once fried.
lighter: Fish, sambal and lalapan with half rice is 460 calories and 26g protein. That is a good meal.
Ask for the fish 'jangan terlalu kering' (not too crispy). Less time in the oil, a little less oil absorbed.
Skip the fried tempe and tahu that come with the komplit set. Together they are about 165 calories.
Eat all the lalapan. Cabbage and cucumber cost nothing and fill the same space as rice.
Order teh tawar instead of es teh manis. Saves 90 calories.

faq.q: How many calories in pecel lele?
faq.a: About 330 calories for one fried catfish with sambal and lalapan, and about 590 with a plate of rice.

faq.q: Is pecel lele healthy?
faq.a: The fish has 24g protein, but deep frying roughly doubles its calories. Grilled lele (lele bakar) is about 220 calories versus 290 fried.

faq.q: How many calories in fried catfish?
faq.a: Around 194 calories per 100g cooked according to FatSecret Indonesia, so 290 for a normal 150g tent-sized fish.

faq.q: How many calories in pecel lele with rice and es teh?
faq.a: About 680 calories: 330 for the fish plate, 260 for rice and 90 for the sweet iced tea.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (pecel lele 292 kcal per 150g serving), sambal and lalapan estimated

foods.name: Tempe Goreng
foods.metaDescription: Two pieces of warung tempe goreng are about 190 calories with 12g protein. Frying adds about 45 calories a piece, and the flour-battered mendoan adds more.
foods.summary: Tempe goreng is sliced fermented soybean cake, marinated in garlic, coriander and salt, and shallow fried until golden. It is the default protein side at every warteg in Indonesia.
foods.answer: Two warung-sized pieces of tempe goreng are about 190 calories with 12g protein. FatSecret Indonesia lists 225 calories per 100g fried and 192 for an 85g serving. Tempe mendoan with a thick flour batter is about 120 per piece.
realTalk: Raw tempe is about 190 calories per 100g and 19g protein, which is already one of the best protein deals in Indonesia at Rp 5,000 a block. Frying pushes that to about 225 per 100g because the slices soak up oil, roughly 5g per two pieces. So the frying costs you 45 calories and gives you the crunch. A warung piece is 35 to 45g, so two is about 190.

The version matters. Plain tempe goreng bumbu (marinated, no batter) is the lightest. Tempe goreng tepung has a thin batter that adds about 20 calories a piece. Tempe mendoan from Purwokerto is a thin slice in a thick soft batter, fried briefly, about 120 calories each, and the batter is more than the tempe. Tempe orek (fried shreds in kecap manis) is about 90 for a 40g spoon and a third of it is sugar.

At a warteg, tempe goreng is Rp 2,000 to 3,000 a piece and people take two or three next to rice and a vegetable. Three pieces is 285 calories with 18g protein, which is more protein than a piece of chicken skin and less fat. It is one of the few fried things here that is worth it.
The catch is the oil quality. Warteg oil gets reused a lot, and thick pieces fried in old oil at low heat absorb more. Thin, hot, quick fried tempe is both tastier and lighter.
lighter: Tempe bacem or tempe rebus (braised or steamed) is about 60 calories per piece against 95 fried, though bacem has sugar.
Plain marinated tempe goreng over mendoan. The thick batter doubles the calories.
Two pieces is a good protein side. Four pieces is a fried meal.
At home, air fry or pan fry with a teaspoon of oil. Tempe crisps without deep frying.
Skip tempe orek if you are watching sugar. It is fried and then glazed in kecap manis.

components.name: Garlic coriander marinade and light flour

variants.name: Tempe bacem (2 pieces)
variants.note: Braised in palm sugar, briefly fried

faq.q: How many calories in tempe goreng?
faq.a: About 95 calories per warung-sized piece and 190 for two, with 12g protein. FatSecret Indonesia lists 225 calories per 100g fried.

faq.q: Is tempe goreng good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes, as fried food goes. Two pieces give 12g protein for 190 calories, better than most fried sides. Steamed or bacem tempe is lighter still.

faq.q: How many calories in tempe mendoan?
faq.a: About 120 calories per piece. The thick flour batter holds more oil than the tempe itself.

faq.q: Does frying tempe destroy the protein?
faq.a: No. Frying adds oil calories but the protein stays, around 6g per piece. What changes is the fat, from about 4g raw to 6g fried per piece.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (tempe goreng 225 kcal/100g, 192 kcal per 85g serving)

foods.name: Opor Ayam
foods.serving: 1 bowl (1 large piece bone-in chicken with gravy, no rice or ketupat)
foods.metaDescription: A serving of opor ayam is about 390 calories, one piece of chicken in coconut gravy. With ketupat at Lebaran it is over 600 before the sambal goreng ati.
foods.summary: Opor ayam is chicken simmered in a mild coconut milk gravy with galangal, lemongrass, candlenut and coriander. It is the Lebaran dish, served with ketupat and sambal goreng.
foods.answer: A serving of opor ayam is about 390 calories: one large bone-in piece of chicken (around 150g) with 90ml of coconut gravy. FatSecret Indonesia lists it at 163 calories per 100g and 392 for a 240g bowl, with 34g protein.
realTalk: Opor is milder than gulai but it is still coconut milk, and that is where the fat comes from. Of the 24g fat in a bowl, roughly half is the chicken skin and half is the santan. A 150g piece of thigh with skin is about 250 calories; the 90ml of gravy it sits in is about 130. If you eat breast without skin and only a spoon of gravy, the same bowl is 260.

The protein is the good part. 34g per serving is high, because the piece is big and it is simmered rather than fried, so nothing is lost to a crust. On a normal day at a warung this is Rp 15,000 to 20,000 with rice, and the meal is about 650 calories, which is a fair trade for that much protein.

Lebaran is when it gets out of hand. Two ketupat (290), opor with the fattiest piece (450), sambal goreng ati (200) and kerupuk (50) is a 1,000 calorie plate, and then the relatives serve it again at the next house. Three houses is 3,000 calories, and that is where the Lebaran kilo comes from. Not the opor, the repetition.
Opor putih (white, no turmeric) and opor kuning (yellow) are the same in calories. The Solo style with thicker santan is about 40 calories heavier per bowl than the thinner Jakarta version.
lighter: Pick the breast piece (dada). About 60 calories less than the thigh, same gravy.
Take the chicken out of the gravy and leave most of the santan in the pot. Half the gravy is 65 calories saved.
One ketupat, not two. Each one is 145.
Skip the sambal goreng ati at Lebaran. Liver in coconut chili is about 200 calories per spoon and it is the fattiest thing on the table.
At home, use light santan (santan encer) or half the coconut milk and top up with stock.

portions.label: Lebaran plate with 2 ketupat and sambal goreng ati

variants.name: Ketupat opor Lebaran plate
variants.note: 2 ketupat, opor, sambal goreng ati, kerupuk

faq.q: How many calories in opor ayam?
faq.a: About 390 calories for one large piece of chicken with coconut gravy. FatSecret Indonesia lists 163 calories per 100g.

faq.q: How many calories in ketupat opor?
faq.a: About 680 calories for two ketupat and a serving of opor. With sambal goreng ati and kerupuk the Lebaran plate is around 1,000.

faq.q: Is opor ayam high in fat?
faq.a: Moderate, about 24g per serving. Half is from the chicken skin and half from the coconut milk. Breast without skin cuts it to about 12g.

faq.q: How much protein in opor ayam?
faq.a: About 34g per serving, which is one of the highest of any Indonesian lauk because the piece is large and simmered, not fried.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (opor ayam 163 kcal/100g, 392 kcal per 240g bowl)

foods.name: Telur Balado
foods.metaDescription: One telur balado is about 130 calories: a boiled egg, fried until blistered, coated in red chili sambal. The cheapest protein at any warteg.
foods.summary: Telur balado is a hard-boiled egg fried until the outside blisters, then tossed in a chili, shallot and tomato sambal. It sits in the window of every warteg and nasi Padang shop in Indonesia.
foods.answer: One telur balado is about 130 calories: 72 for the egg, about 35 for the oil it picks up when fried, and around 25 for the sambal balado. FatSecret Indonesia lists it at 71 calories per egg, but that figure does not account for the frying, so 130 is the honest warung number.
realTalk: A hard-boiled egg is 72 calories. Warteg telur balado is not just a boiled egg. It goes into hot oil until the white blisters, which is what lets the sambal stick, and that step adds about 4g of oil, 35 calories. Then the sambal, which is chili, shallot and tomato ground and fried in oil, another 25 for a coating. So 130 per egg, and 7g protein.

That still makes it the cheapest protein on the shelf. At Rp 3,000 to 5,000 an egg, two telur balado is 260 calories and 14g protein, which is more protein than a piece of tempe goreng and less fat than a piece of ayam goreng at 390. With a plate of rice and a spoon of sayur, two eggs is a 500 calorie warteg lunch.

The Padang version (telur balado at a nasi Padang shop) is oilier because the balado is cooked longer with more oil and sits in a tray of it. Expect 150 per egg there. The Manado telur rica-rica version is similar. Telur dadar (omelette) is a different thing entirely, about 150 to 200 for one thick warteg slice because it is fried in far more oil.
The sambal is where the calories vary. A light coating is 25 calories. If the server gives you an extra spoon of the red oil from the bottom of the tray, that is 45 more.
lighter: Ask for the egg 'tanpa minyak' or shake off the oil before it goes on the plate. The sambal oil is 45 calories a spoon.
Telur rebus or telur pindang (plain boiled or spiced boiled) is 72 to 75 calories. Same protein, no frying.
Two telur balado and no other fried lauk is a good warteg plate at 260 calories for 14g protein.
Pair with sayur bening or sayur asem instead of sayur lodeh. Clear vegetables are 60 to 80 per bowl versus 160.
At home, skip the frying step and put the sambal straight on the boiled egg. About 95 calories.

portions.label: 2 telur balado, Padang style with extra oil

variants.name: Telur balado, home style not fried

faq.q: How many calories in telur balado?
faq.a: About 130 calories per egg at a warteg: the egg is 72, the frying adds about 35 and the sambal about 25. FatSecret lists 71 for the egg alone.

faq.q: Is telur balado good for a diet?
faq.a: Yes. It is 7g protein for 130 calories and costs Rp 3,000 to 5,000. Two eggs with rice and a clear vegetable soup is a balanced warteg meal around 500 calories.

faq.q: How many calories in telur balado with rice?
faq.a: About 390 calories for one egg with a 200g plate of rice, or 520 with two eggs.

faq.q: Is telur balado high in fat?
faq.a: About 10g fat per egg, 5g from the yolk and the rest from frying oil and sambal. Boiled egg in sambal without frying drops it to 6g.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (telur balado 71 kcal per egg) adjusted for frying oil and sambal

foods.name: Ayam Goreng Kremes
foods.metaDescription: One piece of ayam goreng kremes is about 480 calories. The chicken is 390 and the pile of crispy kremes crumbs adds 90 more.
foods.summary: Ayam goreng kremes is chicken simmered in coconut water and spices, deep fried, then buried under kremes: a crunchy flour and spice batter dripped into hot oil. Yogyakarta's Kalasan and Suharti restaurants made it famous.
foods.answer: One piece of ayam goreng kremes is about 480 calories. FatSecret Indonesia lists a piece of ayam goreng at 391 calories, and the handful of kremes on top adds about 90 because it is nothing but fried batter. With rice the plate is around 740.
realTalk: The chicken is already the fried kind, around 391 calories for a bone-in piece with skin according to FatSecret, and the Kalasan method simmers it in coconut water and garlic first so the meat is seasoned through. Then it goes in the fryer. That part is standard ayam goreng, 34g protein and about 22g fat.

Kremes is the extra. It is rice flour, tapioca, the leftover simmering stock and spices, whisked thin and dripped into hot oil so it fluffs into lace. A generous 20g pile is about 90 calories and it is 55% fat. It is also the reason people order this over plain ayam goreng, so nobody is going to leave it. Some restaurants give 40g and that is 180.

The restaurant set at Rp 30,000 to 50,000 comes with rice, lalapan and sambal, so the standard meal is about 740. Add tempe goreng and tahu and the plate is 900. A Suharti-style quarter chicken (two pieces) with kremes and rice is 1,100.

Compared to ayam bakar at 290 or ayam kampung goreng at about 330 (smaller, leaner bird), kremes is the heaviest chicken order on the menu after geprek keju. The kampung chicken version of kremes is about 420 because the bird is smaller.
lighter: Ask for dada (breast) and eat the kremes but not the skin. That is about 380 instead of 480.
Ask for 'kremesnya sedikit'. Half the crumbs is 45 calories saved.
Half rice. The meal drops from 740 to 610.
Ayam kampung kremes is a smaller bird, about 60 calories less per piece.
Skip the tempe and tahu that come in the set. Together they are 165 calories.

components.name: Fried chicken, bone-in thigh with skin

faq.q: How many calories in ayam goreng kremes?
faq.a: About 480 calories for one bone-in piece with a normal pile of kremes. With rice the set is around 740.

faq.q: How many calories in kremes alone?
faq.a: About 90 calories for a 20g handful, or 180 for the big restaurant pile. It is fried batter, so roughly 450 calories per 100g.

faq.q: Ayam kremes or ayam bakar?
faq.a: Ayam bakar at about 290 per piece is far lighter than kremes at 480. Same amount of protein, the difference is all oil.

faq.q: Is ayam goreng kremes high in protein?
faq.a: Yes, about 34g per piece. The problem is it comes with 30g fat, most of it from the frying and the kremes.

foods.source: FatSecret Indonesia (ayam goreng 391 kcal per piece), kremes estimated from components

foods.name: Pad Thai
foods.metaDescription: A street stall plate of pad thai with shrimp and egg is about 577 calories. Here is where the number comes from and how to order it lighter.
foods.summary: Thin rice noodles stir fried with egg, shrimp or chicken, bean sprouts, chives and a tamarind and palm sugar sauce, finished with crushed peanuts. Thailand's most exported plate of food.
foods.answer: One plate of pad thai with shrimp and egg is about 577 calories for a 250g street stall serving, based on the Thai Department of Health food table. The noodles and the sweet sauce carry most of it. Shrimp adds almost nothing, the oil and peanuts add a lot.
realTalk: The 577 figure is for a modest stall plate. Sit down in a tourist area restaurant and the plate grows to 350g with a second egg and a heavier pour of oil, and you are at 750 to 800 calories without changing the recipe. The rice noodles alone are about 215 calories per plate, the sauce is another 70, and the cook's ladle of oil is 120 or more depending on how generous they are.

The sauce is the sneaky part. Pad thai sauce is tamarind, fish sauce and a lot of palm sugar, about 15g of sugar per plate. That is why it tastes sweet even when it looks savoury. Squeezing the lime over it does not cancel anything, it just balances the taste. The crushed peanuts on the side are 60 calories per tablespoon, so if you spoon on three, that is a whole extra egg's worth.

Compared with the other stall noodle plates, pad thai sits in the middle. Pad see ew is heavier at 679, rad na is lighter at 397. If you are picking one plate a day from the noodle cart, pad thai at 577 is fine. It only becomes a problem when it is the 40 baht second dinner after a full meal, which is how a lot of people actually eat it.
lighter: Ask for goong sod (fresh shrimp) rather than chicken or pork; shrimp is about 50 calories for 4 pieces versus 100 to 130 for the same weight of pork.
Say mai sai nam man yer (not much oil). Most cooks will happily use half a ladle instead of a full one, which saves 60 to 80 calories.
Skip the extra peanuts and extra sugar packet on the table. The plate already has 15g of sugar in the sauce.
Order pad thai hor kai (wrapped in a thin omelette) only if you count the extra egg; it adds around 100 calories.

portions.label: Standard plate with shrimp and egg
Large restaurant plate with extra egg and peanuts

variants.name: Pad thai with tofu (vegetarian)
variants.note: Tofu is lighter than meat but takes more oil

variants.name: Pad thai with chicken
variants.note: Chicken breast adds protein at low cost

variants.name: Pad thai goong sod (shrimp)
variants.note: Thai Department of Health figure for 244g

variants.name: Pad thai hor kai (omelette wrapped)
variants.note: Extra egg plus more oil for the wrap

faq.q: Is pad thai healthy?
faq.a: It is a balanced plate for the calories: 577 calories with about 20g protein and some vegetables. The weak points are 15g of sugar in the sauce and 22g of fat, mostly from oil. One plate is a reasonable meal, two plates is not.

faq.q: How many calories in pad thai without egg?
faq.a: Take off about 60 to 70 calories, so around 510 for a standard plate. Keep the egg though, it is the cheapest protein on the plate.

faq.q: Is pad thai or pad see ew higher in calories?
faq.a: Pad see ew. The Thai Department of Health lists pad see ew with pork and egg at 679 calories versus 577 for pad thai with shrimp, because wide rice noodles soak up more oil and dark soy.

foods.source: Thai Department of Health (กรมอนามัย) food table via health.kapook.com, pad thai goong sod sai kai 244g = 577 kcal

foods.name: Pad Kra Pao
aka: ข้าวผัดกะเพราไก่ไข่ดาว
foods.serving: 1 plate with rice and fried egg
foods.metaDescription: Pad kra pao gai over rice with a fried egg is about 630 calories. The egg and the oil add 150 of that. Numbers from the Thai Department of Health.
foods.summary: Minced chicken or pork stir fried with holy basil, garlic, chili and fish sauce, served over rice with a crispy fried egg on top. The default lunch order in every Thai food court and aharn tam sang shop.
foods.answer: A plate of pad kra pao gai with rice and a fried egg is about 630 calories, based on the Thai Department of Health table for khao pad kra pao gai kai dao. Without the fried egg the same plate is 478 calories at 265g. The egg fried in the wok oil adds roughly 150.
realTalk: The chicken and basil part is honest food: 100g of minced chicken is 165 calories and the basil, chili and garlic are nearly zero. The rice is 260 for a normal 200g scoop. What pushes the plate past 600 is the fried egg, which soaks up wok oil until the edges go crispy and lands at 110 to 150 calories on its own, plus the tablespoon of oil the cook used for the stir fry.

Meat choice changes the number more than most people think. Minced chicken keeps it at 630. Swap to minced pork and it climbs to about 680 because Thai minced pork is usually 20 to 25 percent fat. Order kra pao moo krob (crispy pork belly) and you are at 820 or more, since 70g of moo krob is nearly 300 calories by itself.

This was my default 45 baht lunch for a long time and it is a perfectly good one. The trick I settled on: keep the egg, ask for less oil, and do not order the extra rice. A 630 calorie plate with 30g of protein is a full meal. A 900 calorie plate with kao piset (extra rice) and moo krob is two meals.
lighter: Ask for kai dao mai krob (egg not crispy) or a boiled egg instead; a soft fried egg absorbs less oil and saves 40 to 60 calories.
Choose minced chicken over minced pork, roughly 50 calories less per plate.
Order with less rice (khao noi) if the shop lets you, which drops the plate by about 80 calories.
Skip the fish sauce with chili on the table; it is not calories, but it is a lot of sodium on top of an already salty dish.

portions.label: Pork belly (moo krob) with fried egg

variants.name: Kra pao moo sap kai dao
Kra pao moo krob kai dao

faq.q: How many calories in pad kra pao without rice?
faq.a: The stir fry alone, with chicken, is about 260 calories. Add 110 for the fried egg. Eating it without rice is a legitimate low carb move, though most people then order more meat.

faq.q: Is pad kra pao good for weight loss?
faq.a: Yes if it is one plate. 630 calories with 30g of protein is a decent lunch. Order it with chicken, one egg, normal rice, and you fit it into almost any daily target.

faq.q: Why does the same dish vary so much between shops?
faq.a: Oil. One shop uses a tablespoon for the stir fry, another uses three, and the fried egg can take 5 to 15g of oil depending on how crispy they make it. That alone is a 150 calorie swing.

foods.source: Thai Department of Health (กรมอนามัย) via health.kapook.com: khao pad kra pao gai kai dao 630 kcal; without egg 265g = 478 kcal

foods.name: Som Tam
foods.metaDescription: Som tam thai is about 150 calories a plate. The papaya is almost free; the palm sugar and peanuts are the whole number. Full breakdown inside.
foods.summary: Shredded green papaya pounded in a clay mortar with lime, fish sauce, palm sugar, chili, garlic, tomato, long bean, dried shrimp and peanuts. The most ordered salad in Thailand, usually eaten with sticky rice and grilled meat.
foods.answer: A plate of som tam thai is about 150 calories for a 150g serving. The Thai Department of Health lists the classic recipe at 105 calories per 100g. Green papaya itself is under 40 calories per 100g; the peanuts and palm sugar in the dressing are what add up.
realTalk: Som tam on its own is one of the lightest plates in Thai food. 100g of green papaya is about 40 calories, and the lime, chili, garlic and fish sauce add nothing meaningful. The 150 calorie total comes from about a tablespoon of palm sugar (55 calories) and a small handful of roasted peanuts (45 to 60 calories). Ask for no peanuts and less sugar and you are eating an 80 calorie plate.

The problem was never the som tam. It is the table. A standard isaan order is som tam, a bag of sticky rice and gai yang or moo ping. The sticky rice bag is 260 calories, the grilled chicken thigh is 300, and the whole meal lands around 700. That is still a decent dinner, but people think of it as a salad and go back for a second bag of rice.

Variants matter. Tam pu pla ra (with fermented fish and salted crab, no peanuts, less sugar) is about 80 calories. Tam khai khem (with salted egg) is around 210. Tam thai at 150 is the middle. If you want the most food for the least calories, pu pla ra wins, as long as you can handle the smell.
lighter: Ask for mai wan (not sweet) or wan noi (less sweet). The palm sugar is a third of the calories.
Skip the peanuts, or ask for half. Each tablespoon is 60 calories.
Order it with grilled chicken and one bag of sticky rice, not two. That keeps the full meal around 700 calories.
Tam pu pla ra without peanuts is the lightest version at about 80 calories.

components.name: Palm sugar and fish sauce dressing

portions.label: Tam pu pla ra, no peanuts
Tam thai with 1 bag sticky rice

variants.name: Tam pu pla ra (fermented fish, salted crab)
Tam tad (large tray with sides)
variants.note: Shared platter with noodles, pork rind, eggs

faq.q: Is som tam good for weight loss?
faq.a: Very. At 150 calories for a full plate with lots of fibre and crunch it fills you up for almost nothing. The meal only gets heavy from the sticky rice and grilled meat next to it.

faq.q: How many calories in som tam with sticky rice?
faq.a: A plate of tam thai (150) plus a 150g bag of khao niao (260) is about 410 calories. Add a grilled chicken thigh and the set is around 700.

faq.q: Which som tam has the fewest calories?
faq.a: Tam pu pla ra without peanuts, around 80 calories a plate. Tam thai is 150 because of sugar and peanuts. Anything with salted egg, pork rind or instant noodles goes above 200.

foods.source: Thai Department of Health (กรมอนามัย): som tam thai 105 kcal per 100g, scaled to a 150g stall plate; eatwellconcept.com dietitian estimate 120 to 150 kcal per plate

foods.name: Tom Kha Gai
foods.metaDescription: A bowl of tom kha gai is about 320 calories, and roughly 180 of that is coconut milk. Chicken and mushrooms are the cheap part. Breakdown inside.
foods.summary: Chicken and mushrooms simmered in coconut milk with galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaf and lime juice. The mild, creamy cousin of tom yum, and the one tourists order when they want less chili.
foods.answer: A 300g bowl of tom kha gai is about 320 calories. Published Thai figures run from 210 for a small cup to 420 for a rich restaurant bowl, and the whole gap is coconut milk. Around 100ml of coconut milk is 180 calories; the chicken is 130; everything else is under 20.
realTalk: Tom kha is tom yum with coconut milk, and that one change turns a 100 calorie soup into a 320 calorie one. Every 100ml of coconut milk is about 180 calories, and a restaurant bowl can have 150ml. That is why the published numbers scatter so much: a 210 calorie version is made with a thin coconut broth, a 420 calorie one is made with thick coconut cream.

The good news is the rest of the bowl is cheap. 80g of chicken is 130 calories and 18g of protein. Straw mushrooms, galangal, lemongrass and lime leaf add maybe 20 calories combined. So the bowl is filling, high in protein for a soup, and the fat is the only thing to watch. At 24g of fat per bowl it is the fattiest soup on the Thai menu.

Treat it as a main, not a side. A bowl of tom kha with a small plate of rice (200 calories) is a 520 calorie meal, which is fine. Tom kha as a starter before green curry and pad thai is where the coconut stacks up and the meal quietly passes 1,200.
lighter: Order it as tom kha, not tom kha nam khon (thick); a thinner broth uses light coconut milk and saves 80 to 100 calories.
Eat the chicken and mushrooms and leave half the broth; the broth holds most of the fat.
Make it the main with a small rice, instead of a starter before curry.
At home, use 60ml coconut milk topped up with chicken stock; the taste holds and the bowl drops to about 200 calories.

faq.q: Is tom kha gai healthy?
faq.a: It is a high protein soup with 18g of protein a bowl, but 24g of fat from coconut milk. Fine as a main with rice, heavy as a starter. Tom yum at about 100 calories is the lighter choice if you just want soup.

faq.q: Tom kha gai vs tom yum, which is lower in calories?
faq.a: Tom yum by a wide margin. A clear tom yum gai is around 100 calories a bowl; tom kha gai is about 320 because of the coconut milk.

faq.q: How many calories in tom kha gai with rice?
faq.a: About 520 for a bowl plus a 150g plate of rice. That is a reasonable lunch with good protein.

foods.source: Estimate from components. Published Thai figures: kawtung.com 210 kcal per cup, foodmany.com and others 400 to 420 kcal per bowl; picked 320 for a standard 300g stall bowl

foods.name: Green Curry (Gaeng Keow Wan)
aka: แกงเขียวหวาน
แกงเขียวหวานไก่
foods.metaDescription: Green curry with chicken is 240 calories a bowl and about 500 with a plate of rice. The coconut milk is most of it. Thai Department of Health figures.
foods.summary: Chicken, Thai eggplant and basil in a coconut milk curry made from green chili paste. Sweet, hot and creamy, eaten with rice or poured over khanom jeen rice noodles.
foods.answer: A bowl of gaeng keow wan gai is about 240 calories on its own, per the Thai Department of Health, and about 500 calories once you add a 200g plate of rice. The coconut milk is 145 of the 240; the chicken is 80; the eggplant and basil are almost nothing.
realTalk: The official Thai figure of 240 calories per cup surprises people because it sounds low for a coconut curry. It is low because a food court ladle is about 80ml of coconut milk and 50g of chicken. Restaurant green curry is a different animal: a full bowl with 150ml of thick coconut cream and 120g of chicken is closer to 480, which is the figure some Thai calorie tables list.
